title: CAE 業務における問題例​
content: 繰り返しの操作は、ユーザーが退屈で不快になる可能性があります。自動化のない反復作業は、望ましい期間内に完了できない可能性があります。手動の操作はオペレーションミスを引き起こす可能性があります。複雑なモデリングの場合、詳細なCAE トレーニングが必要になることがあります。各企業には独自のデザインルール/プロセス、デザイン仕様/テンプレートなどがあるため、各ユーザーに固有の UIがあるとより便利です。

title: PSJ：自動化とカスタマイズ用​
url: docs/5.0.4/#psj自動化とカスタマイズ用
content: このような問題を解決し、さまざまなユーザーからの要件を満たすために、4F motoを使用して PSJ(Python Scripting for Jupiter）が開発されています。

title: 注目機能​
content: PSJ を使用すると、次の機能を利用できます。 Python スクリプトの Jupiter 関数 Jupiter Pre/Post 機能の組み込み他のソフトウェアとの接続Python3.x とその膨大なライブラリと互換性があります GUI コマンドビルダー：メイン製品と同等の GUI ダイアログが簡単に作成できます。 カスタマイズされた IDE：自動補完・ツールチップなどのプログラミングのサポートが充実しています。 カスタマイズされたシェル：デバッグのエラー出力が可能です。 詳細情報 その他 PSJ ソリューションの詳細は、専用のサンプルアプリケーションをご覧ください。

title: コードのハイライト​
content: Python キーワードや PSJ-API が異なる色で強調表示されます。 この強調表示対象のキーワードはデータベースフォルダに保存されています。 また、単語をダブルクリックした時は同じ単語がハイライト表示（黄色）されます。

title: オートコンプリート​
content: IDE に入力した文字列に基づいて、入力しようとしている単語を予測し、候補を表示します。 たとえば、「Geometry.Me」と入力すると、「Me」で始まる単語が表示されます。  オートコンプリートのデータはデータベースフォルダに保存されており、以下をサポートします。 IDE 内のすべての単語Python キーワードPSJ-ユーティリティPSJ-コマンド

title: ツールチップ​
content: 単語を入力すると、その単語の補足説明などが表示されます。 たとえば、 JPT.ClearLog（と入力すると、 JPT.ClearLogドキュメントを示すツールチップが表示されます。  定義した関数の docstring も表示されます。  ツールチップのデータはデータベースフォルダに保存されています。

title: スクリプトのグループブロック（折りたたみ/展開）​
url: docs/5.0.4/customized-ide#スクリプトのグループブロック折りたたみ展開
content: コードブロックのグループ化をサポートしています。（コードの一部を表示／非表示ができます。）

title: File メニュー​
content: 名前	説明	ショートカットキーNew	新規のドキュメントを開きます。	^ Ctrl + N Open	保存済の Python スクリプトファイルを開きます。	^ Ctrl + O Save	Python スクリプトファイルを保存します。	^ Ctrl + S Save As	Python スクリプトファイルに別名をつけて保存します。	^ Ctrl + E Exit	IDE を終了します。	^ Ctrl + Q

title: Edit メニュー​
content: 名前	説明	ショートカットキーUndo	実行した操作を取り消し、ひとつ前の状態に戻します。	^ Ctrl + Z Redo	取り消した操作を再実行します。	^ Ctrl + Y Cut	選択したテキストを切り取ります。	^ Ctrl + X Copy	選択したテキストをコピーします。	^ Ctrl + C Paste	カット/コピーしたテキストを貼り付けます。	^ Ctrl + V Import Macro Log	実行したコマンドのマクロを JPT.Exec（macro command）の形式でインポートします。	^ Ctrl + M Import Python Macro Log	実行された PSJ-コマンドをインポートします。	^ Ctrl + J Import Script From Last Run	IDE で最後に実行した Python スクリプトをインポートします。	^ Ctrl + L Find	スクリプトで特定の文字を検索します。	^ Ctrl + F Comment	選択したスクリプトの前にコメントタグ ＃を挿入します。	^ Ctrl + K Toggle Comment	コメント ⇔ コメント解除の切り替えを行います。	^ Ctrl + T Go To Line	スクリプトの特定の行に移動します。	^ Ctrl + G Find And Replace	スクリプト内の特定の文字を見つけて置き換えます。	^ Ctrl + H

title: View メニュー​
content: 名前	説明	ショートカットキーToggle Text Wrapping	IDE のサイズに合わせたコードの折り返し表示の設定をおこないます。	^ Ctrl + W

title: Run メニュー​
content: 名前	説明	ショートカットキーRun All	すべてのスクリプトを実行します。	F5 Run Selected	選択されているスクリプトのみを実行します。	F6

title: データベース​
content: IDE データベースは、Jupiter インストールフォルダー/ IDEData /に保存されます。 このデータベースは編集できます。 各ファイルの内容 Keywords.dat：IDE 上でハイライトされるキーワードPSJCommandCalltips.dat：PSJ-コマンドのオートコンプリートとツールチップデータPSJUtilityCalltips.dat：PSJ-ユーティリティのオートコンプリートとツールチップデータPSJPythonHelperCalltips.dat：PSJPython ヘルパーのコールチップ

title: ③ コマンドラインインターフェイス （CLI）​
url: docs/5.0.4/customized-shell#-コマンドラインインターフェイス-cli
content: PSJ を 1 行ずつ直接実行できます。 コピー^ Ctrl + Cおよび貼り付け^ Ctrl + V操作がサポートされています（1 行または複数行のコマンドをサポート）↑ 上または↓ 下キーボタンを使用して前後のコマンドに移動できます。 ログウィンドウの行をダブルクリックし、コマンドをコピーして CLI に貼り付けることもできます。⇥ タブを使用して [マクロ](./macro)、[PSJ-コマンド](./psj-command)、[PSJ-ユーティリティ](./psj-utility)のキーワードを自動入力します。 キーワードが入力された後、^ Ctrl + ↑ 上を使用して戻るか、^ Ctrl + ↓ 下を使用して近くのキーワードに進むことができます。

title: iEntityType​
content: An Integer specifying the type of the selected entity, which must be one of the following:1: Part2: Face3: Edge8: Face point9: Edge point10: Solid pointThe default value is 0 (Unspecified type).

title: bEnableSizeParams​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to set local size parameter or not. If this parameter is True, dAvgElemSize, dMaxElemSize and dMinElemSize will be used.The default value is False.

title: dAvgElemSize​
content: A Double specifying the average mesh size of the selected entity. This parameter is used only when bEnableSizeParams is True.The default value is 0.0.

title: dMaxElemSize​
content: A Double specifying the maximum mesh size of the selected entity. This parameter must be greater than dAvgElemSize, at least 1.4*dAvgElemSize. This parameter is used only when bEnableSizeParams is True.The default value is 0.0.

title: dMinElemSize​
content: A Double specifying the minimum mesh size of the selected entity. This parameter must be smaller than dAvgElemSize, at most 0.7*dAvgElemSize. This parameter is used only when bEnableSizeParams is True.The default value is 0.0.

title: bEnableTrimAngle​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to set trim angle parameter or not. If this parameter is True, dTrimAngle will be used. This parameter is mainly used for local mesh setting on Edge type entity.The default value is False.

title: dTrimAngle​
content: A Double specifying the largest control angle allowed when generating mesh on edges. This angle is defined as the angle formed by two consecutive 1D elements. This parameter is used only when bEnableTrimAngle is True.The default value is 0.0.

title: bEnableMeshCount​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to set mesh count parameter or not. If this parameter is True, iNodeCount will be used. This parameter is mainly used for local mesh setting on Edge type entity. The default value is False.

title: iNodeCount​
content: An Integer specifying number of nodes when generating mesh on edges. This parameter is used only when bEnableMeshCount is True.The default value is 0.

title: iBiasNodeId​
content: An Integer specifying bias node ID. Dense area of bias set up will start from this node. The parameter is used only when bEnableMeshCount is True and iBiasMethod is 1 (Bias).The default value is 0.

title: dBiasFactor​
content: A Double specifying bias factor, which could be the equal ratio r (if iBiasProgression is 0) or the equal difference (if iBiasProgression is 1). This parameter can only be used only when bEnableMeshCount is True and iBiasMethod is 2 or 3.The default value is 0.0.

title: iBiasMethod​
content: An Integer specifying bias method. This parameter is mainly used for local mesh setting on Edge type entity. The number of node to set up is specified in iNodeCount, with bias factor dBiasFactor and progression method iBiasProgression. This parameter and can be one of the following0: Equal: no bias is set up, nodes are equally distributed.1: Bias: bias is set up, nodes are distributed so that dense area starts from node with id iBiasNodeId.2: Bias-sides: bias is set up, nodes are distributed so that dense area starts from both 2 bounding nodes of the edge.3: Bias-center: bias is set up, nodes are distributed so that dense area is at the middle distance of the edge.This parameter is used only when bEnableMeshCount is True.The default value is 0.

title: iBiasProgression​
content: An Integer specifying bias progression method, which can be one of the following:0: Geometric: distance of nodes will increase by an equal ratio r, where r is bias factor dBiasFactor. For example, when r = 2, if distance between first node and second node is 1, distance between second and third node will be 1 * r = 2, and the next distance will be 4.1: Arithmetic: distance of nodes will increase by an equal difference d, where d is bias factor dBiasFactor. For example, when d = 2, if distance between first node and second node is 1, distance between second and third node will be 1 + d = 3, and the next distance will be 5.This parameter is used only when bEnableMeshCount is True and iBiasMethod is 2 or 3.The default value is 0.

title: bEnableMeshPattern​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to force a specify mesh pattern on the selected entity or not. If this parameter is True, iMeshPatternType will be used. This parameter is mainly used for local mesh setting on Face entity type.The default value is False.

title: iMeshPatternType​
content: An Integer specifying mesh pattern type, which can be of the following:0: Unstructured: a mesh pattern with equilateral triangles are formed.1: Structured: a mesh pattern with right angle triangles are formed (isometric pattern).2: Imprinting-Iso: a mesh pattern with isometric mesh is imprinted on faces with holes in the middle.This parameter is used only when bEnableMeshPattern is True.The default value is 0.

title: bEnableKeepEntity​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to keep this entity when meshing or not. For better mesh quality, when meshing, some edges or faces will be merged or deleted. If this parameter is True, the entity is prevented from being merged or deleted.The default value is False.

title: Syntax​
content: msgbox.add_button(...)

title: pos​

title: Sample Code​
content: from pyjdg import * def main(): msgbox=PSJMessageBox() msgbox.set_caption(text="PSJ Message Box") msgbox.set_header(text="") msgbox.set_icon(icon_type=msgbox_icon.error) msgbox.set_message(text="This is an error message box") msgbox.add_button(pos=msgbox_position.first, text="First") msgbox.add_button(pos=msgbox_position.second, text="Second") msgbox.add_button(pos=msgbox_position.third, text="Third") print("clicked:"+msgbox.show()) if __name__=='__main__': main()

title: Description​
content: An instance of a TableColumnInfo class, represents attributes of a target column inside table.

title: Input​
content: To create a TableColumnInfo object, defines a variable with TableColumnInfo(...).

title: name​
content: A String specifying the name of column.This is a required input.

title: type​
content: An Integer A String specifying the data type validation for the column of table.Support 3 types: "String", "Integer" and "Double".This is a required input.

title: precision​
content: An Integer specifying number of digits after floating point displayed inside a Double column.The default value is 2.

title: filter​
content: A Boolean specifying the state of filter mode of column of table. True: filter mode will be shown.False: filter mode will be hidden. The default value is False.

title: Attributes​
content: Get attributes of TableColumnInfo.

title: column_name​
content: A String specifying the name of column.

title: column_type​
content: An Integer specifying the data type validation for the column of table.

title: column_precision​
content: An Integer specifying number of digits after floating point displayed inside a Double column.The default value is 2.

title: column_filter​
content: An Integer specifying the state of filter mode of column of table. 1: filter mode is using.0: filter mode is not using. The default value is 0.

title: Remarks​
content: Based on the specifying data type of type, all cells of that column accept only that type. If precision is specified to the column which is "String" or "Integer" type, the data type of that column and value of cells will not change. To use filter option, user can set True state to shows filter mode; set False state or ignore this option in script - the both ways will trigger the same action that hides filter mode.

title: Introduction​
content: VSCode is an open-source text editor, with the ability to install various extensions to make your Python development faster and easier. Besides all the features of the current Jupiter built-in IDE, VSCode also provides: A debuggerAn AI co-pilotLinkage to online/local Scripting API documentLinting (Hint for fixing the code)  注意 This is beta version, please do not use for real application. If you have any feedback or question, please contact us.

title: Install instruction​
content: Install VSCode extension for code highlight, suggestion and snippet via this link Install a Python library for Jupiter-Connection/Debugger using below command (change the link in double quote below if Jupiter was installed in different location): python -m pip install "C:\Program Files\TechnoStar\Jupiter_5.0\tools\jupiterutils-3.9.tar.gz" In VSCode, before writing PSJ script, remember to import the installed module using from jupiterutils import *

content: ボタン	説明S	Python ファイルを登録します C	登録済みの Python ファイルをクリアします R	登録済みの Python ファイルを別の Python ファイルに置き換えます Func	登録した Python プログラムを実行します

title: 操作方法​
content: Sボタンをクリックして、Python ファイルを選択します。 ファイルを選択すると、ファンクションボタンの左側にある緑色のマークが赤に変わります。 ファンクションボタンをクリックしてプログラムを実行します。

title: PSJを始めましょう
content: PSJを始めましょう PSJ を最大限に活用するためのトピックを紹介します。 紹介ビデオ - これらの入門ビデオでPSJとの旅を始めてください。チュートリアル - PSJ を使用したアプリケーションの作成例です。PSJ の構造 - PSJ の基本構造を理解します。スクリプト API - スクリプト API マニュアルです。（右上隅にある検索機能を使用することもできます。）PSJ の拡張機能 - スクリプトの記述をより効果的にサポートする機能の紹介です。外部 IDE - 他のソフトウェアに接続して複雑なスクリプトを作成する場合は、Visual Studio Code 拡張機能を使用することをお勧めします。

title: Q1. How can I use format with macro that have parameters with {}?​
content: Using % targetParts=[3:1] JPT.Exec('VolMeshing(%s, {1, 1.05, 0, 0.1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 4, 1, 1, 1, 0}, 0, 65280)'%(targetParts))  Using .format{} targetParts=[3:1] params={1, 1.05, 0, 0.1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 4, 1, 1, 1, 0} JPT.Exec('VolMeshing({0}, {1}, 0, 65280)'.format(targetParts,params)  or targetParts=[3:1] JPT.Exec('VolMeshing({0}, {{1, 1.05, 0, 0.1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 4, 1, 1, 1, 0}}, 0, 65280)'.format(targetParts)

title: Q2. How can I get entities inside a group?​
content: groups=JPT.GetAllGroups() for g in groups: for e in g.targets: print(str(e.typeID)+' '+str(e.id))

title: Q3. How can I get multiple return value splitting each of them?​
content: import re from itertools import groupby def remove_dup_char(s, c): return ''.join(c if a==c else ''.join(b) for a,b in groupby(s)) result=JPT.Exec('FindHoles([], [], 0, 12.345, 0)') splitted = re.split(r',\s*(?![^(\[\]]*\])', result) res = [] for s in splitted: s = remove_dup_char(s, '[') s = remove_dup_char(s, ']') print (s)

title: Q4. Which and how many methods DItem has?​
content: obj = JPT.DItem() for x in dir(obj): print(x)

title: Q5. How can I get Master/Slave entities from the selected entity?​
content: sel = JPT.GetAllSelected() for s in sel: for m in s.masters: print(str(m.id)) for s in s.slaves: print(str(s.id))

title: Q6. How can I get elapsed time for each command?​
content: import time start = time.time() # Write commands to measure elapsed time elapsed_time = time.time() - start

title: Q7. How can I rename a part?​
content: JPT.Exec('RenameItem("newname", 3:5)')

title: Q8. How can I install a new module?​
content: Installation by folder copy (up to V4.0.x) Check the Python version of Jupiter (in V4.0.2 is 3.6.3).Install the same Python version to your machine.Install the module using the pip command in Python to your machine. -> A module folder will be created under the \Lib\site-package folder in the Python installation folder.Copy the created folder under the Jupiter-Pre installation folder \Lib\site-packages. Install with pip (V4.1 or later) Open a command prompt with administrator modeMove to Jupiter installation folderEnter the following command: python -m pip install <module>  危険 If you update Jupiter, the additional installed libraries will basically remain. However, if the Python version of Jupiter has been updated, the library may stop working. In that case, please reinstall the appropriate version of the library.

title: はじめに​
content: マクロは Jupiter ビルドイン機能と同等ですが、GUIはありません。 例： CreateCube（[0、0、0]、[10、10、10]、[10、10、10]、 "Cube_1"、7105764、0：0） ： デフォルトの入力値で立方体を作成します。ImprintLineS（[[7.8、0、10]、[2.2、10、10]]、[6:26]、1） ： 面上の２点間にエッジを引きます。 これらのマクロは、マクロ機能が正常に実行された直後に生成されます。 マクロウィンドウを使用して、記録、実行、保存、および再読み込みできます。 マクロウィンドウ上部にはツールバーが配置されており、左から、マクロの読み込み・保存・記録・巻き戻し・再生・次へ・停止・マクロ実行時間間隔を調節の操作となっています。  使用可能なマクロのリストは、スクリプト APIを参照してください。

title: Description​
content: Measure Mass By Property

title: Syntax​
content: MeasureMassByProperty (Cursor[] parts, Cursor[] massConditions, String strTarget, Bool bGravityCenter, Cursor crRefCoord, int iPrecision)

title: 1. Cursor[]​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of parts to measure the mass. This argurment could be in Part type and/or Bar type. If this parameter is [], massConditions must be specified.

title: 2. Cursor[]​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of mass conditions. If this is [], parts must be specified.

title: 3. String​
content: A String specifying the target value of mass information to be outputted. Depending on the target information, this parameter can be one of the following: If strTarget="Mass": Return the mass value.If strTarget="Gravity Center X": Return the X position of Gravity Center.If strTarget="Gravity Center Y": Return the Y position of Gravity Center.If strTarget="Gravity Center Z": Return the Z position of Gravity Center.If strTarget="Moment Inertial XX": Return the Moment of Inertia about X axis.If strTarget="Moment Inertial YY": Return the Moment of Inertia about Y axis.If strTarget="Moment Inertial ZZ": Return the Moment of Inertia about Z axis.If strTarget="Moment Inertial XY": Return the product of Moment of Inertia on XY.If strTarget="Moment Inertial YZ": Return the product of Moment of Inertia on YZ.If strTarget="Moment Inertial XZ": Return the product of Moment of Inertia on XZ.If strTarget="Principal Moment X": Return the Moment of Inertia about Principal axis 11.If strTarget="Principal Moment Y": Return the Moment of Inertia about Principal axis 22.If strTarget="Principal Moment Z": Return the Moment of Inertia about Principal axis 33.If strTarget="Traits Vector XX": Return the X direction of Principal axis 11.If strTarget="Traits Vector XY": Return the Y direction of Principal axis 11.If strTarget="Traits Vector XZ": Return the Z direction of Principal axis 11.If strTarget="Traits Vector YX": Return the X direction of Principal axis 22.If strTarget="Traits Vector YY": Return the Y direction of Principal axis 22.If strTarget="Traits Vector YZ": Return the Z direction of Principal axis 22.If strTarget="Traits Vector ZX": Return the X direction of Principal axis 33.If strTarget="Traits Vector ZY": Return the Y direction of Principal axis 33.If strTarget="Traits Vector ZZ": Return the Z direction of Principal axis 33.If strTarget="Euler Angle X": Return the rotation angle of main axis with X axis.If strTarget="Euler Angle Y": Return the rotation angle of main axis with Y axis.If strTarget="Euler Angle Z": Return the rotation angle of main axis with Z axis. The default value is "Mass".

title: 4. Bool​
content: A Boolean specifying the use of gravity center Coordinate System to measure the mass.

title: 5. Cursor​
content: A Cursor specifying the Coordinate System to measure the mass. This parameter cannot be used when bGravityCenter is True.The default value is None (Global Coordinate).

title: 6. int​
content: An Integer specifying the number of digit after floating point. The greater iPrecision could be, the more accuracy of mass value can be measured.The default value is 6.

title: Return Code​
content: A Double specifying the value of Mass information.

title: Sample Code​
content: MeasureMassByProperty([3:1], [], "Mass", 0, 0:0, 6)

title: Description​
content: Measure Mass By Material.

title: Syntax​
content: MeasureMassByMaterial. (Cursor[] parts, Cursor[] massConditions, double dMaterialDensity, String strTarget, Bool bGravityCenter, Cursor crRefCoord, int iPrecision)

title: 1. Cursor[]​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of parts to measure the mass. This argurment could be in Part type and/or Bar type. If this parameter is [], massConditions must be specified.

title: 2. Cursor[]​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of mass conditions. If this is [], parts must be specified.

title: 3. double[]​
content: A String specifying the material density (default unit: kg/m3).

title: 4. String​
content: A String specifying the target value of mass information to be outputted. Depending on the target information, this parameter can be one of the following: If strTarget="Mass": Return the mass value.If strTarget="Gravity Center X": Return the X position of Gravity Center.If strTarget="Gravity Center Y": Return the Y position of Gravity Center.If strTarget="Gravity Center Z": Return the Z position of Gravity Center.If strTarget="Moment Inertial XX": Return the Moment of Inertia about X axis.If strTarget="Moment Inertial YY": Return the Moment of Inertia about Y axis.If strTarget="Moment Inertial ZZ": Return the Moment of Inertia about Z axis.If strTarget="Moment Inertial XY": Return the product of Moment of Inertia on XY.If strTarget="Moment Inertial YZ": Return the product of Moment of Inertia on YZ.If strTarget="Moment Inertial XZ": Return the product of Moment of Inertia on XZ.If strTarget="Principal Moment X": Return the Moment of Inertia about Principal axis 11.If strTarget="Principal Moment Y": Return the Moment of Inertia about Principal axis 22.If strTarget="Principal Moment Z": Return the Moment of Inertia about Principal axis 33.If strTarget="Traits Vector XX": Return the X direction of Principal axis 11.If strTarget="Traits Vector XY": Return the Y direction of Principal axis 11.If strTarget="Traits Vector XZ": Return the Z direction of Principal axis 11.If strTarget="Traits Vector YX": Return the X direction of Principal axis 22.If strTarget="Traits Vector YY": Return the Y direction of Principal axis 22.If strTarget="Traits Vector YZ": Return the Z direction of Principal axis 22.If strTarget="Traits Vector ZX": Return the X direction of Principal axis 33.If strTarget="Traits Vector ZY": Return the Y direction of Principal axis 33.If strTarget="Traits Vector ZZ": Return the Z direction of Principal axis 33.If strTarget="Euler Angle X": Return the rotation angle of main axis with X axis.If strTarget="Euler Angle Y": Return the rotation angle of main axis with Y axis.If strTarget="Euler Angle Z": Return the rotation angle of main axis with Z axis. The default value is "Mass".

title: 5. Bool​
content: A Boolean specifying the use of gravity center Coordinate System to measure the mass.

title: 6. Cursor​
content: A Cursor specifying the Coordinate System to measure the mass. This parameter cannot be used when bGravityCenter is True.The default value is None (Global Coordinate).

title: 7. int​
content: An Integer specifying the number of digit after floating point. The greater iPrecision could be, the more accuracy of mass value can be measured.The default value is 6.

title: Return Code​
content: A Double specifying the value of Mass information.

title: Sample Code​
content: MeasureMassByMaterial([3:1], [], 2300, "Mass", 0, 0:0, 6)

title: 前書き​
content: マクロと同等ですが、PSJ-コマンドは、コンパクトで、書きやすく、Python と完全に互換性があるように洗練されています。 この新しい PSJ 機能は、Jupiter バージョン 5 から導入されました。

title: クラスベース形式​
content: PSJ-コマンドの関数は、クラスベースの形式とJupiter のリボンにちなんで名付けられています。 たとえば、デフォルトの入力値で立方体を作成します。 PSJ-コマンドマクロ Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[0, 0, 0], dlLength=[10, 10, 10], ilAxialNodes=[10, 10, 10], strName="Cube_1", iPartColor=7105764, crLocalCoordinate=None)  PSJ-コマンド の引数は、標準の命名規則に従います。

title: コンパクト​
content: PSJ-コマンドのパラメーターは、デフォルト値が使用されている場合は無視されます。 たとえば、デフォルトの入力値で立方体を作成します。 PSJ-コマンドマクロ Geometry.Part.Cube()

title: 明示的​
content: PSJ-コマンドは、明示的な定義のおかげで読みやすくなっています。 たとえば、面上の２点間にエッジを引きます： PSJ-コマンドマクロ Geometry.Edge.Line(veclPosition=[[7.8, 0, 10], [2.2, 10, 10]], crlTargetFace=[Face(26)])

title: 戻り値​
content: PSJ-コマンドには、コードをより Pythonicに見せることができる戻り値があります。 たとえば、作成したばかりの 2 つのキューブを削除します: PSJ-コマンドマクロ cube1 = Geometry.Part.Cube() cube2 = Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[10.0, 0.0, 0.0], strName="Cube_2", iPartColor=6409934) Geometry.DeleteEntity.Part(crlParts=[cube1, cube2])

title: エラー処理​
content: PSJ-コマンドにはエラー処理が組み込まれています。これにより、開発者はバグをすばやく簡単に見つけることができます。 たとえば、次のように間違った形式でコードを入力します。 # 以下の入力の2番目のパラメーターの名前が間違っています Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[10.0, 0.0, 0.0], strame="Cube_1")  上記のコードを実行すると、PythonAPI ウィンドウにエラーが表示されます。

title: IDE がサポートされています​

title: Description​
content: Create and export the ADVC (*.adx) file for the Heat Transfer analysis.

title: Syntax​
content: Analysis.ADVC.HeatTransfer(...)  Ribbon: Analysis » ADVC » Heat Transfer

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the job name of ADVC analysis. This name would be the name of analysis job in Assembly Tree and the name of ADX file after exported.This is a required input.

title: strDescription​
content: A String specifying the description for ADVC analysis job. The description would write in ADX file, where contents will be written below ModelInfo.The default value is "".

title: crlProcessSequence​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the ADVC process sequences. This argument controls the Process solution type and its setting information depended on solution type.The default value is [].

title: crlElemLocationGroup​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the element locations. The model contains Element group such as 3D Element, 2D Element, 1D Element to use this argument.The default value is [].

title: crlNodeLocationGroup​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the node locations. The model contains Node group to use this argument.The default value is [].

title: bWriteGroup​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to write group which output a selected group of Faces, Elements, Nodes as Surface Segment, Element Set and Node set respectively. If bWriteGroup=True, the ADX file would contained group information such as Part, Face, Element(3D, 2D, 1D), Node,... The default value is False.

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying the existing ADVC job in Assembly Tree. If this argument is not None, the specified ADVC job will be modified. Otherwise, a new job will be created.The default value is None.

title: bResultReference​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use the settings of Result Reference. If bResultReference=True, the settings of Result Reference arguments will be valid to use. The default value is False.

title: iSeparateFile​
content: An Integer specifying the method to separate file. This option allows to separate information into many exported ADX files by the specified type. If iSeparateFile=0, this option would export only 1 ADX file contains all information of all bodies/parts in the model (ModelInfo, Unit, Geometry, LBCs, Process Sequence,...).If iSeparateFile=1, this option would export 2 ADX files, which the first ADX file has same name as analysis Job will contain general information (such as ModelInfo, Unit, LBCs, Job name, Process Sequence, other settings of ADVC Structure analysis). When the last one ADX file which has suffix name "_model", contains Geometry information (such as Node, Part, Element,...).If iSeparateFile=2, this option would export ADX files, which each body/part in model would be written individually Geometry information, Group in model would be written in another file, while other information would be written in the ADX file has same name as analysis Job.If iSeparateFile=3, this option would export ADX file that write information of selected part/body. If selection does not have at least a specific body/part, Jupiter would write all bodies/part (same option as iSeparateFile=0).If iSeparateFile=4, this option would export 1 ADX file contains LBCs information of the chosen LBCs. The default value is 0.

title: bExportRelatedAllLBCs​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to export all related Load Boundary Condition. This argument is to be used when iSeparateFile=3. If True, this option would export ADX file contains related information to LBCs such as Contact, Connection RBE, Bolt Pretension,... The default value is False.

title: bUseEntityName​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use entity name in exported file or not. If True, this option would export ADX file that write Entity name to Geometry information such as Part, Face,...If False, this option would export ADX file without writing Entities name to Geometry information. The default value is False.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of targets. The target could be Part or LBCs item.The default value is [].

title: iLoadType​
content: An Integer specifying the load type used for analysis. If iLoadType=0: Load Case, which is a group of specific Loads, BCs applies on the model. The model could apply many Load Cases which may have same setting of LBCs. Exporting ADX file would write all Load Cases.If iLoadType=1: Load, which will export ADX file stores all Loads, BCs as a 1 Load case only. The default value is 1.

title: bSameOutputOnAllProcess​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use the same output request for all processes. If True, set same output request (Displacement, Stress, Strain,...) for all defined processes.If False, set output request which will base on user's desired result for each process. The default value is True.

title: bDeleteFloatingNode​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to delete floating nodes or not. If True, the exported ADX file would not write the floating nodes information.If False, the exported ADX file would write the floating nodes information. The default value is True.

title: bBC​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to separate boundary condition. This argument is to be used when iSeparateFile=3. If True, the exported ADX file would write LBCs information. The default value is True.

title: bCheckBCDuplicate​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to check if duplicate the boundary conditions. If True, to check LBCs duplication when export ADX file. The default value is False.

title: bAutoAssignDummyProp​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to automatically assign dummy property for dummy entities. This argument is to be used when the model has that unassigned property. If True, the model would be exported with dummy property for the Part that does not have property. The others Part (which already assigned property) will export with its property setting.If False, the model will export ADX file in case of the model has all property in all Parts, but if there is one Part that does not have property in the model, this option will not export file. The default value is False.

title: crDummyPropMaterial​
content: A Cursor specifying the dummy property material for automatically assigning dummy property when export ADX file.The default value is None.

title: bReferenceRestartData​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use the Reference Restart Data. If True, the settings of Reference Restart Data arguments will be valid to use.If False, the settings of Reference Restart Data arguments will be ignored even though User has set value or not. The default value is False.

title: strReferenceRestartDataPath​
content: A String specifying the path of Reference Restart Data.The default value is "".

title: iNumberProcesses​
content: An Integer specifying the number of processes for Reference Restart Data.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iNumberSteps​
content: An Integer specifying the number steps of Reference Restart Data.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iCoordinateType​
content: An Integer specifying the coordinate type of Reference Restart Data. If iCoordinateType=0: Initial typeIf iCoordinateType=1: Deformation type The default value is 0.

title: iUpdateContactSearch​
content: An Integer specifying whether to update contact search for Reference Restart Data. If iUpdateContactSearch=0: NoIf iUpdateContactSearch=1: Yes The default value is 1.

title: listLoadNodeContact​
content: A List of LOAD_NODE_CONTACT specifying the list of load node contacts.The default value is [].

title: iHeatConvection​
content: An Integer specifying the Heat Convection type. There are 2 types of Heat Convection: If iHeatConvection=0: DirectIf iHeatConvection=1: Indirect The default value is 1.

title: strPath​
content: A String specifying the exporting path for ADX file.The default value is "".

title: iNumType​
content: An Integer specifying the numeric format type. This argument would allow numeric setting type of adx file. If iNumType=0: Real Type - The numerical values in real number format (e.g 123.456).If iNumType=1: Power Type - The numerical values in exponential/scientific format (e.g 1.234E-005). The default value is 0.

title: iUiWidth​
content: An Integer specifying the limitation number of digits before the point of the number. This option allows to control number digits of value in exported ADX file.The default value is 10.

title: iUiPrecision​
content: An Integer specifying the limitation number of digits after the point of the number. This option allows to control number digits of value in exported ADX file.The default value is 1.

title: bExportGeometryID​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to write geometry ID number.The default value is False.

title: bSeparatePartInfoFile​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to separate Part Information Files.The default value is False.

title: strADVCTemplateFilePath​
content: A String specifying the path of ADVC Template File.The default value is "".

title: bOutputDefinition​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that sets the output request.The default value is True.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created jobs.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=5619133) Meshing.SolidMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1)], bTet10=True, dGradingFactor=1.05, dStretchLimit=0.1, iSpeedVsQual=1, iRegion=1, bSafeMode=False, iParallel=12, bInternalMeshOnly=False, iPartColor=65280) Properties.Material.Add("Concrete", [Density([(DENSITY, 2.3e-09)]), Elastic([(YOUNGS_MODULUS, 30000.0), (POISSONS_RATIO, 0.18)])]) Properties.Solid(crlTargets=[Part(1)], strName="Solid Property 1", iPropertyColor=12275404, crMaterial=Material(1), iCordM=-2, dDynaRemeshVal1=DFLT_DBL, dDynaRemeshVal2=DFLT_DBL, dDispHG=DFLT_DBL, iFLG=-1) Analysis.ADVC.MakeProcess.SteadyState(strName="Process_0") creating_status = Analysis.ADVC.HeatTransfer(strPath="D:/Job_1.adx", strName="Job_1", crlProcessSequence=[ADVCProcessSSH(1)], crlTargets=[Part(1)], bAutoAssignDummyProp=True, crDummyPropMaterial=Material(1), listLoadNodeContact=[], iUiPrecision=6, bExportGeometryID=True) JPT.Debugger(creating_status)

content: A Double specifying the maximum change of temperature. This argument is to be used when iFixedOrAuto=1.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

content: An Integer specifying whether to use the maximum dt time to calculate the incrementation when iFixedOrAuto=1.The default value is 0.

title: dMaxDt​
content: A Double specifying the maximum dt time. This argument is to be used when iFixedOrAuto=1.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iDefineMinDt​
content: An Integer specifying whether to use the minimum dt time to calculate the incrementation when iFixedOrAuto=1.The default value is 0.

title: dRestartTimeInterval​
content: A Double specifying the restart time interval.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

content: An Integer specifying the output initial.The default value is -1.

title: dCgTotalDispLimitTol​

title: dNewtonTol​
content: A Double specifying the Newton tolerance.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dNewtonDispTol​
content: A Double specifying the Newton displacement tolerance.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dNewtonDispLimitTol​
content: A Double specifying the Newton displacement limit tolerance.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dNewtonTotalDispLimitTol​
content: A Double specifying the Newton total displacement limit tolerance.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iCgloopMax​
content: An Integer specifying the convergence of loop maximum.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iNewtonMax​
content: An Integer specifying the Newton maximum.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: dHtNlLoopTol​
content: A Double specifying the heat transfer nl loop tolerance.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iHtNlLoopMax​
content: An Integer specifying the heat transfer nl loop maximum.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying the existing ADVC process to be modified. If the default value is specified, a new process will be created, otherwise the specified ADVC process will be modified.The default value is None.

title: listLoadCaseNode​
content: A List of ADVC_LOAD_NODE specifying the loadcase node.If this argument is specified, the listLoadNode will be empty.The default value is [].

title: listLoadNodeContact​

title: Description​
content: Export the ADVENTURECluster solver file in adx format with the existing Job in Assembly Tree. By pointing out the desired ADVC Job in Assembly Tree, exporting could be done multiple times with user's setting.

title: Syntax​
content: Analysis.ExportAdx(...)  Macro: ExportAdx Ribbon: Analysis » Export Adx

title: crJob​
content: A Cursor specifying the ADVC analysis Job in Assembly Tree by using identification number (ID number) of the Job.This is a required input.

title: strPath​
content: A String specifying the destination path file to export. The destination path should be different from C Drive (C:/) due to Window would deny saving any files to C Drive directly (It is recommended to save in User's Drive such as D Drive, E Drive,...)This is a required input.

title: iNumType​
content: An Integer specifying the numeric format type. This argument would allow numeric setting type of adx file. If iNumType=0: Real Type - The numerical values in real number format (123.456).If iNumType=1: Power Type - The numerical values in exponential/scientific format (1.234E-005).If iNumType=2: Auto Type - The numerical values would show in both above types depending on value of model The default value is 0.

title: iUiWidth​
content: An Integer specifying the limitation number of digits before the point of the number. This option allows to control number digits of value in exported ADX file.The default value is 10.

title: iUiPrecision​
content: An Integer specifying the limitation number of digits after the point of the number. This option allows to control number digits of value in exported ADX file.The default value is 1.

title: Return Code​
content: An Boolean specifying the status of the exporting process: True: The ADVC (*.adx) file has been exported successfully.False: The ADVC (*.adx) file cannot be exported.

title: Description​
content: Create and export the ADVC (*.adx) file for the Structure analysis.

title: Syntax​
content: Analysis.ADVC.Structure(...)  Ribbon: Analysis » ADVC » Structure

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the job name of ADVC analysis. This name would be the name of analysis job in Assembly Tree and the name of the ADX file after exported.The default value is "".

title: strDescription​
content: A String specifying the description for ADVC analysis job. The description would write in the ADX file, where contents will be written below ModelInfo.The default value is "".

title: crlProcessSequence​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of ADVC process sequence. This argument controls the Process solution type and its setting information depended on solution type.The default value is [].

title: crlElemLocationGroup​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of element location. The model contains element group such as 3D Element, 2D Element, 1D Element to use this argument.The default value is [].

title: crlNodeLocationGroup​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of node location. The model contains node group to use this argument.The default value is [].

title: bWriteGroup​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the write group option which output a selected group of faces, elements, nodes as Surface Segment, Element Set and Node set respectively. If True, ADX file would contained group information such as Part, Face, Element(3D,2D,1D), Node,...If False, ADX won't write group information. The default value is False.

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing ADVC job in Assembly Tree to modify it. If this parameter is used, the specified ADVC job will be modified. If it is left None, a new ADVC job will be created.The default value is None.

title: bResultReference​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the Result Reference option is defined or not. If True, this option will allow to active settings of Result Reference. The settings of Result Reference arguments will be valid to use.If False, this option will be disable settings of Result Reference. In this case, the settings of Result Reference arguments will be ignored even though User has set value or not. The default value is False.

title: iSeparateFile​
content: An Integer specifying the separate file type. This option allows to separate information into many exported ADX files by selected type. If iSeparateFile=0: None, this option would export only 1 ADX file contains all information of all bodies/parts in the model (ModelInfo, Unit, Geometry, LBCs, Process Sequence,...)If iSeparateFile=1: By Model, this option would export 2 ADX files, which the first ADX file has same name as analysis Job will contain general information (such as ModelInfo, Unit, LBCs, Job name, Process Sequence, other settings of ADVC Structure analysis). When the last one ADX file which has suffix name "_model", contains Geometry information (such as Node, Part, Element,...)If iSeparateFile=2: By Body, this option would export ADX files, which each body/part in model would be written individually Geometry information, Group in model would be written in another file, while other information would be written in the ADX file has same name as analysis Job.If iSeparateFile=3: By Selected Body, this option would export ADX file that write information of selected part/body. If selection does not have at least a specific body/part, Jupiter would write all bodies/part (same option as None).If iSeparateFile=4: By Selected LBCs, this option would export 1 ADX file contains LBCs information of the chosen LBCs. The default value is 0.

title: bExportRelatedAllLBCs​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that export all related Load Boundary Condition. This option could be used when iSeparateFile=3(By Selected Body), if not, this setting is not activated for both True or False. If True, this option would export the ADX file contains related information to LBCs such as Contact, Connection RBE, Bolt Pretension,...If False, this option won't export related information to LBCs such as Contact, Connection RBE, Bolt Pretension,... The default value is False.

title: bUseEntityName​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that use entity name in exported file or not. If True, this option would export the ADX file that write Entity name(Name of the Part/Entity) to Geometry information such as Part, Face,...If False, this option would export the ADX file without writing Entities name to Geometry information. The default value is False.

title: bMatrixSolverParam​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that the Matrix Solver Parameter is defined ot not. If True, this option will allow to active settings of Matrix Solver Parameter. The settings of Matrix Solver Parameter arguments will be valid to use.If False, this option will be disable settings of Matrix Solver Parameter. In this case, the settings of Matrix Solver Parameter arguments will be ignored even though User has set value or not. The default value is False.

title: iPreconditionType​
content: An Integer specifying the precondition type. If iPreconditionType=0: ScalingIf iPreconditionType=1: CGCGIf iPreconditionType=2: CGCG2If iPreconditionType=3: CGCG2_DiagIf iPreconditionType=4: CGCG2-SOR The default value is 0.

title: iMatrixStructure​
content: An Integer specifying the matrix structure type. If iMatrixStructure=0: SymmetryIf iMatrixStructure=1: Asymmetry The default value is 0.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of targets. The target could be Part or LBCs item.The default value is [].

title: iLoadType​
content: An Integer specifying the load type uses for analysis. If iLoadType=0: Load Case, which is a group of specific Loads, BCs applies on model. The model could apply many Load Cases which may have same setting of LBCs. Exporting ADX file would write all Load Cases.If iLoadType=1: Load, which will export the ADX file stores all Loads, BCs as a 1 Load case only. The default value is 1.

title: bSameOutputOnAllProcess​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the same output request for all processes. If True, this option would set same output request (Displacement, Stress, Strain,...) for all defined processes.If False, this option would set output request which will base on user's desired result for each process. The default value is True.

title: bDeleteFloatingNode​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that would delete floating node or not. If True, this option would export an ADX file without writing floating nodes information.If False, this option would export an ADX file with floating nodes information. The default value is True.

title: bBC​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that would separate boundary condition. This option could be used when iSeparateFile=3 (By Selected Body), if not, this setting is not activated for both True or False. If True, this option would export an ADX file would write LBCs information.If False, this option won't export an ADX file would write LBCs information. The default value is True.

title: bCheckBCDuplicate​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable checking whether boundary conditions are duplicated or not. If True, this option checks LBCs duplication when export the ADX file.If False, this option won't check LBCs duplication when export the ADX file. The default value is False.

title: bAutoAssignDummyProp​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable automatically assign dummy property option. This option used when model that has not assign property yet. If the model already has property If True, the model would be exported with dummy property for the Part that does not have property. The others Part (which already assigned property) will export with its property setting.If False, the model will export ADX file in case of the model has all property in all Parts, but if there is one Part that does not have property in the model, this option will not export file. The default value is False.

title: crDummyPropMaterial​
content: A Cursor specifying the dummy property material for automatically assigning dummy property when export the ADX file.The default value is None.

title: bReferenceRestartData​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the Reference Restart Data is defined or not. If True, this option will allow to active settings of Reference Restart Data. The settings of Reference Restart Data arguments will be valid to use.If False, this option will be disable settings of Reference Restart Data. In this case, the settings of Reference Restart Data arguments will be ignored even though User has set value or not. The default value is False.

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the job name of Nastran analysis.The default value is "Job_1".

title: strDescription​
content: A String specifying the description of Nastran analysis job.The default value is "".

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying list of target parts.The default value is [].

title: nastranAnalysis​
content: An NASTRAN_ANALYSIS specifying the Nastran analysis input parameter.The default value is NASTRAN_ANALYSIS.

title: bDummyPropAutoAssign​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to enable or disable the auto dummy properties creation option.The default value is False.

title: iDummyPropMaterialID​
content: An Integer specifying the material ID which is used for dummy property assignment.The default value is 0.

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing Nastran job. If this parameter is used, the specified job will be modified.If it is left None, a new job will be created. The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created job.

title: Sample Code​
content: from os import environ import re Geometry.Part.Cube() Meshing.SolidMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1)], bTet10=True, dGradingFactor=1.05, dStretchLimit=0.1, iSpeedVsQual=1, iRegion=1, bSafeMode=False, iParallel=12, bInternalMeshOnly=False, iPartColor=65280) Properties.Material.Add("Concrete", [Density([(DENSITY, 2.3e-09)]), Elastic([(YOUNGS_MODULUS, 30000.0), (POISSONS_RATIO, 0.18)])]) Properties.Solid(crlTargets=[Part(1)], strName="Solid Property 1", iPropertyColor=16131973, crMaterial=Material(1), iCordM=-2, dDynaRemeshVal1=DFLT_DBL, dDynaRemeshVal2=DFLT_DBL, dDispHG=DFLT_DBL, iFLG=-1) BoundaryConditions.FixedConstraint(crlTargets=[Face(25)]) BoundaryConditions.Pressure.General(dPressure=10.0, dlDirection=[0.0, 0.0, -1.0], crlTargets=[Face(26)]) nastran_param = NASTRAN_ANALYSIS(iSolverType=1, iGridFormatType=1, dEpsilon=DFLT_DBL, iMaxNumOfIter=DFLT_INT, iMemory=DFLT_INT, iNcpu=1, iSolNo=101, nastranOutputRequest=NASTRAN_OUTPUT_REQUEST(iValueBcresults=DFLT_INT, iValueBgresults=DFLT_INT, iTypeStrain=0), nastranNonlinear=NASTRAN_NONLINEAR(iKMETHOD=3, iMAXITER=1, bUseEPSW=True)) exported_job = Analysis.NastranJob(nastranAnalysis = nastran_param, iDummyPropMaterialID=5) JPT.Debugger(exported_job)

title: Description​
content: Create TechnoStar Solver Job which is necessary for Analysis.TSSolver.ExportDynamisBdf.

title: Syntax​
content: Analysis.TSSolver.Job(...)  Macro: DynamisJob

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the job name of TechnoStar solver. Output set by this name will be saved in the Assembly tree.The default value is "Job_1".

title: strDescription​
content: A String specifying the description of TechnoStar solver job.The default value is "".

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of target part.The default value is [] (all parts in the model).

title: nastranAnalysis​
content: A NASTRAN_ANALYSIS specifying the TechnoStar solver input parameter.The default value is NASTRAN_ANALYSIS.

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying the created TechnoStar solver job. If this parameter is used, the value will be DynamisJob(ID), where ID is the ID of the solver job had been created. If it is left None, a new TechnoStar solver job will be created.The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created jobs.

title: Description​
content: Create a force in the normal direction applies on selected Face, Edge, Node/MidNode, Normal(Element). User inputs the force value, and it will apply the force to the selected items.

title: Syntax​
content: BoundaryConditions.Force.NormalDirection(...)  Ribbon: Boundary Conditions » Force » Normal Direction

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the force setting.The default value is "ForceNormal1".

title: dForce​
content: A Double specifying the total force value (default unit: N).The default value is 0.

title: crElemForNormal​
content: A Cursor specifying a 2D element. This element will be used to calculate vector normal for force direction.

title: iArrowDir​
content: An Integer specifying the display arrow direction. This parameter only affects the display of the force setting, the force itself remains intact. The value for this parameter is one of the following. 0: Start at node.1: End at node. The default value is 0.

title: iDistributeType​
content: An Integer specifying the force distribution method. The value for this parameter is one of the following. 0: Per selected entity. Each selected item (Face, Edge, Node) receives the same amount of the specified force. For example, a vector force [1; 0; 2] is applied on 2 faces, then each face will receive a vector force [1; 0; 2].1: Per selected node. Each nodes in selected items (Face, Edge, Node) receives the same amount of the specified force. For example, a vector force [1; 0; 2] is applied on 1 edge, which has 10 nodes, then each node will receive a vector force [1; 0; 2].2: Total of selected entity. Each selected item (Face, Edge, Node) receives the same amount of force, which is the specified force divided by the number of selected entity. For example, a vector force [1; 0; 2] is applied on 2 faces, then each face will receive a vector force [0.5; 0; 1]. The default value is 0.

title: crCoord​
content: A Cursor specifying the coordinate from which the fixed constraint is created.The default value is None(global coordinate system).

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of targets for normal direction force. This target can be Face, Edge, Node/MidNode, Normal(Element).The default value is [].

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing normal direction force. If this parameter is used, the specified normal direction force will be modified. If it is left None, a new normal direction force will be created.The default value is None.

content: A Cursor specifying the created LBC.

title: Syntax​

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the new Boundary Condition name.The default value is "SubmodelForcedDisplacement1".

title: iSolver​
content: An Integer specifying the applied Solver. Possible value is 0 corresponding to ADVC solver.The default value is 0.

title: strDataDirectory​
content: A String specifying the data directory name of the global model containing the model, result, and restart. It can be specified as either an absolute path or a relative path.The default value is "/home/".

title: iProcessNo​
content: An Integer specifying the process number.The default value is 0.

title: bMapX​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to map the X translational degree of freedom.The default value is True.

title: bMapY​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to map the Y translational degree of freedom.The default value is True.

title: bMapZ​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to map the Z translational degree of freedom.The default value is True.

title: iReferType​
content: An Integer specifying the reference destination for the result directory of the global model. 0: Not specified - Refers to the normal output result (dir name / result)1: Result - Refer to the normal output result (dir name / result)2: Restart - Refer to the restart output result (dir name / restart) The default value is 0.

title: dExtensionRange​
content: A Double specifying the extension of the range in the global coordinate system. Extend the search range by range in the global coordinate system.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dExtensionTol​
content: A Double specifying the extension of the range in the element coordinate system. Extend the search range by tolerance in the element coordinate system. If specified value smaller than dExtensionLimitTol, the extension parameter in the element coordinate system is dExtensionLimitTol.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dExtensionLimitTol​
content: A Double specifying the Newton-Raphson iteration convergence tolerance for calculating the "global coordinates corresponding to the submodel".The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: strGlobalElementSet​
content: A String specifying the element group name of the "global element containing submodel" that is known in advance.The default value is "".

title: iUseBucket​
content: An Integer specifying whether to use the bucket method to speed up the search. 0: Not specified - Use the bucket method1: Yes - Use the bucket method2: No - Do not use the bucket method The default value is 0.

title: iNumBucketMaxX​
content: An Integer specifying the maximum number of bucket divisions in the x-direction.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iNumBucketMaxY​
content: An Integer specifying the maximum number of bucket divisions in the y-direction.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iNumBucketMaxZ​
content: An Integer specifying the maximum number of bucket divisions in the z-direction.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iPrevBc​
content: An Integer specifying the specified boundary condition to maintain. 0: Not specified1: Default Hold The default value is 0.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the targets to be applied. The target can be Face entities or Node entities. The crlTargets and crForcedDispBC arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is [].

title: crForcedDispBC​
content: A Cursor specifying the existing Boundary Condition (Forced Displacement). If this argument is not None, the specified Boundary Condition will be modified. Otherwise, a new Boundary Condition will be created. The crlTargets and crForcedDispBC arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created LBC.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() created_bcs = BoundaryConditions.Submodel.ForcedDisplacement(crlTargets=[Face(26)]) JPT.Debugger(created_bcs)

content: Create connectors between nodes, edges, and faces according to specified connection types. User selects master/slave targets and the connectors will be created to connect nodes on master/slave targets with each other.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.Connector(...)  Macro: Connector Ribbon: Connections » Connector

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the connection name to be created.The default value is "Connector_1".

title: iMethod​
content: An Integer specifying the connection method. If iMethod=1, the method is Node to Node.If iMethod=2, the method is Edge to Edge.If iMethod=3, the method is Face to Face. The default value is 1.

title: iConnectType​
content: An Integer specifying the connection type. If iConnectType=0, the connection type is Parallel.If iConnectType=1, the connection type is Translation. If iConnectType=2, the connection type is Rotation.If iConnectType=3, the connection type is Bushing.If iConnectType=4, the connection type is Cylindrical.If iConnectType=5, the connection type is Joint.If iConnectType=6, the connection type is RigidRod.If iConnectType=7, the connection type is RigidBar. The default value is 0.

title: iRefNode​
content: An Integer specifying a node to refer to when determining the coordinate system. If iRefNode=0, reference to the first node.If iRefNode=1, reference to the second node. The default value is 0.

title: iElemCs​
content: An Integer specifying the option whether or not an element coordinate system is used. If iElemCs=0, do not use element coordinate system.If iElemCs=1, use element coordinate system. The default value is 0.

title: crLocalCS​
content: A Cursor specifying the local coordinate system.The default value is None.

title: crlElasticity​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the table data of elastic property.The default value is [].

title: crlDamp​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the table data of viscosity characteristics.The default value is [].

title: crlMasterTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of master targets. The targets are nodes when the iMethod is equal to 1.The targets are edges when the iMethod is equal to 2.And the targets are faces when the iMethod is equal to 3. The default value is [].

title: crlSlaveTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of slave targets. The targets are nodes when the iMethod is equal to 1.The targets are edges when the iMethod is equal to 2.And the targets are faces when the iMethod is equal to 3. The default value is [].

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing connection. If this parameter is used, the specified connection will be modified. If it is left None, a new connection will be created. The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created contact.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() created_contact = Connections.Connector(strName="Connector_1", iMethod=3, crlElasticity=[Unknown(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)], crlDamp=[Unknown(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)], crlMasterTargets=[Face(22)], crlSlaveTargets=[Face(21)]) JPT.Debugger(created_contact)

content: A String specifying the contact name.The default value is "ContactAbaqus_1".

title: iContactAlgorithm​
content: An Integer specifying the type of contact connection. 0: Face to Face - Contact between shell or solid element faces and shell or solid element faces.1: Node to Face - Contact between node and shell or solid element faces. The default value is 0.

title: iContactType​
content: An Integer specifying the behavior type of contact definition. The behavior type of contact definition is one of the following. 0: General Type (Sliding Contact)1: Tied Type (Shell-Solid contact)2: All with self Type The default value is 0.

title: iAlg​
content: An Integer specifying the contact setting target entity.The default value is 0.

title: dAdjustVal​
content: A Double specifying the adjustment width of the initial node position.The default value is 0.0.

title: dExtensionZone​
content: A Double specifying the extended area.The default value is 0.0.

title: dMaxPenetration​
content: A Double specifying the maximum penetration distance value.The default value is 0.0.

title: iSmallSliding​
content: An Integer specifying the consideration of small-slip. 0: OFF1: ON The default value is 0.

title: dSmooth​
content: A Double specifying the smoothing angle.The default value is 0.0.

title: iFrictionType​
content: An Integer specifying the friction characteristics type. The friction characteristics type is one of the following. 0: None1: General2: Lagrange3: Rough4: Static & Kinetic The default value is 0.

title: dFrictionCoef1​
content: A Double specifying the friction coefficient 1 when Friction type is set as General or Lagrange.The default value is 0.0.

title: dFrictionCoef2​
content: A Double specifying the friction coefficient 2 when Friction type is set as General or Lagrange.The default value is 0.0.

title: dShearLimit​
content: A Double specifying the Shear stress limit when Friction type is set as General or Lagrange.The default value is 0.0.

title: dSlipTol​
content: A Double specifying the maximum allowable elastic slip for surface dimension ratio when Friction type is set as General or Static & Kinetic.The default value is 0.0.

title: dStaticFrictionCoef​
content: A Double specifying the Coefficient of static friction when Friction type is set as Static & Kinetic.The default value is 0.0.

title: dKineticFrictionCoef​
content: A Double specifying the Coefficient of dynamic friction when Friction type is set as Static & Kinetic.The default value is 0.0.

title: dDecayCoef​
content: A Double specifying the Reduction factor when Friction type is set as Static & Kinetic.The default value is 0.0.

title: iAdjust​
content: An Integer specifying the consideration of adjustment.The default value is 0.

title: dPositionTol​
content: A Double specifying the position tolerance value.The default value is 0.0.

title: iFormula​
content: An Integer specifying the contact formulation type. 0: Node to Surface1: Surface to Surface The default value is 0.

title: iTie​
content: An Integer specifying the fixed conditions and contact pair.The default value is 0.

title: iPOCType​
content: An Integer specifying the Contact thickness of the contact direction behavior, to define the penetration characteristics type.The default value is 0.

title: iAllowSeparation​
content: An Integer specifying the separation option when pressure-overclosure type is set as Hard Contact.The default value is 0.

title: dSlope​
content: A Double specifying the contact stiffness when pressure-overclosure type is set as Linear.The default value is 0.0.

title: tshPOCTsheet​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the table of pressure-Overclosure when pressure-overclosure type is set as Exponential.The default value is [].

title: iClearanceType​
content: An Integer specifying the contact characteristic definition method of heat conduction. 0: None1: Clearance Dependency2: Pressure Dependency3: Clearance & Pressure Dependency The default value is 0.

title: iClearanceTypeId​
content: An Integer specifying the clearance dependency type ID.The default value is 0.

title: bTemperatureDependency​
content: A Boolean enable/disable using temperature dependency data.The default value is False.

title: iDependencies​
content: An Integer specifying number of the field variables.The default value is 0.

title: tshCDTsheet​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the table of clearance dependency.The default value is [].

title: iPrsTypeId​
content: An Integer specifying the pressure dependency type ID.The default value is 0.

title: bPrsTemperatureDependency​
content: A Boolean enable/disable using temperature dependency data.The default value is False.

title: iPrsDependencies​
content: An Integer specifying number of the field variables.The default value is 0.

title: tshPrsDTsheet​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the table of pressure dependency.The default value is [].

title: crplTargets​
content: A Cursor Pair List specifying the list or pair of group master face and group slave face.The default value is [].

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing contact settings item. If this parameter is used, the specified contact settings item will be modified. If it is left None, a new contact settings item will be created.The default value is None.

title: iColor​
content: An Integer specifying the contact color.The default value is 0.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created contact.

title: Description​
content: Define the contact set between the specified group for Abaqus. Create a group with master and slave surfaces beforehand to define the contact in the contact settings.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.Contacts.Abaqus.ManualGroup(...)  Ribbon: Connections » Contacts » Abaqus » Manual Group

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the new Abaqus Contact name.The default value is "ContactAbaqus_1".

title: iContactType​
content: An Integer specifying the behavior type of contact definition. The behavior type of contact definition is one of the following: 0: General (Sliding Contact)1: Tied (Shell-Solid contact)2: All with self - Automatic contact detection The default value is 0.

title: iContactAlgorithm​
content: An Integer specifying the contact setting target entity. 0: Face to Face - Contact between shell or solid element faces and shell or solid element faces.1: Node to Face - Contact between node and shell or solid element faces. The default value is 0.

title: dAdjustWidth​
content: A Double specifying a value to adjust the initial positions of the surfaces specified. This is required when the iTied parameter is used with ON value. This argument is used only when iContactType=0.The default value is 0.0.

title: dExtensionZone​
content: A Double specifying a value that is equal to a fraction of the end segment or facet edge length by which Abaqus extends the master surface to avoid numerical round-off errors associated with contact modeling. The value given must lie between 0.0 and 0.2. This parameter affects only node-to-surface contact. This argument is used only when iContactType=0.The default value is 0.0.

title: dMaxPenetration​
content: A Double specifying the maximum distance by which a point on the slave surface must penetrate the master surface before Abaqus abandons the current increment and tries again with a smaller increment. This parameter does not apply to contact pairs that use the finite-sliding, surface-to-surface contact formulation. This argument is used only when iContactType=0.The default value is 0.0.

title: iSmallSliding​
content: An Integer specifying whether to use the small-sliding contact formulation. This parameter is not allowed with self-contact. This argument is used only when iContactType=0. 0: OFF1: ON The default value is 0.

title: dSmoothAngle​
content: A Double specifying the degree of smoothing used for element-based master surfaces in the finite-sliding, node-to-surface contact formulation. The value given must lie between 0.0 and 0.5. This parameter does not affect contact pairs with analytical rigid surfaces or contact formulations other than the finite-sliding, node-to-surface contact formulation. This argument is used only when iContactType=0.The default value is 0.0.

title: iFrictionType​
content: An Integer specifying the friction characteristics type. This argument is used only when iContactType=0. 0: None1: General2: Lagrange3: Rough4: Static & Kinetic The default value is 0.

title: dFrictionCoeff1​
content: A Double specifying the first friction coefficient to be defined in terms of slip rate. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=1 or iFrictionType=2.The default value is 0.0.

title: dFrictionCoeff2​
content: A Double specifying the second friction coefficient to be defined in terms of slip rate. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=1 or iFrictionType=2.The default value is 0.0.

title: dShearStressLimit​
content: A Double specifying an optional equivalent shear stress limit, so that regardless of the magnitude of the contact pressure stress, sliding will occur if the magnitude of the equivalent shear stress reaches this value. A value of zero is not allowed. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=1 or iFrictionType=2.The default value is 0.0.

title: dSlipTolerance​
content: A Double specifying the maximum allowable elastic slip for surface dimension ratio. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=1 or iFrictionType=4.The default value is 0.0.

title: dStaticFrictionCoeff​
content: A Double specifying the static friction coefficient. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=4.The default value is 0.0.

title: dKineticFrictionCoeff​
content: A Double specifying the dynamic friction coefficient. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=4.The default value is 0.0.

title: dDecayCoeff​
content: A Double specifying the decay coefficient. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=4.The default value is 0.0.

title: bAdjustPosition​
content: An Integer specifying whether to adjust the position of surfaces in the contact pair. This argument is used only when iContactType=1.The default value is False.

title: dPositionTolerance​
content: A Double specifying the tolerance of position of surfaces used for adjustment. This argument is used only when bAdjustPosition=1.The default value is 0.0.

title: iFormulationType​
content: An Integer specifying how Abaqus generates the contact constraint coefficients. This argument is used only when iContactType=0. 0: Node to Surface1: Surface to Surface The default value is 0.

title: iTied​
content: An Integer specifying whether the surfaces in the contact pair are to be tied together for the duration of the analysis. This argument is used only when iContactType=0. 0: Not specified - Not want to tie the surfaces together.1: ON - Tie the surfaces together. The default value is 0.

title: iPressureOverclosureType​
content: An Integer specifying a contact pressure-overclosure relationship. 0: Hard Contact - Pressure-overclosure relationship without physical softening.1: Exponential - Exponential pressure-overclosure relationship.2: Linear - Linear pressure-overclosure relationship.3: Tabular - Piecewise linear pressure-overclosure relationship in tabular form.4: None The default value is 0.

title: bAllowSeparation​
content: An Integer specifying whether to allow separation of the two surfaces once contact has been established. This argument is used when iPressureOverclosureType=0.The default value is False.

title: dContactStiffness​
content: A Double specifying the slope of the pressure-overclosure curve. This value must be positive and is required when iPressureOverclosureType=2.The default value is 0.0.

title: tshPressureOverclosure​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the tabular data of Pressure-Overclosure used for exponential pressure-overclosure relationship. This argument must be specified when iPressureOverclosureType=1 or iPressureOverclosureType=3.The default value is [].

title: iThermalConductanceDef​
content: An Integer specifying the contact characteristic definition method of heat conduction. 0: None1: Clearance Dependency2: Pressure Dependency3: Clearance & Pressure Dependency The default value is 0.

title: bClearanceTemperatureDependency​
content: A Boolean specifying whether the tabular data have Temperature-Dependent property.The default value is False.

title: iClearanceDependencies​
content: An Integer specifying the number of field variables in the data table. This argument must be specified when iThermalConductanceDef=1 or iThermalConductanceDef=3.The default value is 0.

title: tshClearanceData​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the tabular data of clearance dependency.The default value is [].

title: bPressureTemperatureDependency​
content: A Boolean enable/disable using temperature dependency data.The default value is False.

title: iPressureDependencies​
content: An Integer specifying number of the field variables.The default value is 0.

title: tshPressureData​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the table of pressure dependency.The default value is [].

title: crplTargets​
content: A List of Pair of Cursor specifying the list or pair of group master face and group slave face. The crplTargets and crContactAbaqus arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is [].

title: crContactAbaqus​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing Abaqus Contact (Manual Group). If this parameter is used, the specified contact settings will be modified. Otherwise, a new contact settings will be created. The crplTargets and crContactAbaqus arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is None.

title: iContactColor​
content: An Integer specifying the contact color.The default value is 0.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created contact.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=12537679) Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[0.01, 0.0, 0.0], strName="Cube_2", iPartColor=6250449) Tools.Group.CreateGroup(strGroupName="ContactAbaqus_1_Manual_Face_M", crlTargets=[Face(49)]) Tools.Group.CreateGroup(strGroupName="ContactAbaqus_1_Manual_Face_S", crlTargets=[Face(24)]) created_contact = Connections.Contacts.Abaqus.ManualGroup(strName="ContactAbaqus_1", dAdjustWidth=DFLT_DBL, dExtensionZone=DFLT_DBL, dMaxPenetration=DFLT_DBL, iSmallSliding=1, dSmoothAngle=DFLT_DBL, iFrictionType=1, dFrictionCoeff1=DFLT_DBL, dFrictionCoeff2=DFLT_DBL, dShearStressLimit=DFLT_DBL, dSlipTolerance=DFLT_DBL, dStaticFrictionCoeff=DFLT_DBL, dKineticFrictionCoeff=DFLT_DBL, dDecayCoeff=DFLT_DBL, bAdjustPosition=1, dPositionTolerance=DFLT_DBL, iFormulationType=1, iTied=1, iPressureOverclosureType=1, dContactStiffness=DFLT_DBL, tshPressureOverclosure=[0, 0], iThermalConductanceDef=3, tshClearanceData=[1, 2, DFLT_DBL, DFLT_DBL], tshPressureData=[1, 2, DFLT_DBL, DFLT_DBL], crplTargets=[CursorPair(Group(1), Group(2))], iContactColor=16711680) JPT.Debugger(created_contact)
