title: Description​
content: Create and export the ADVC (*.adx) file for the Structure analysis.

title: Syntax​
content: Analysis.ADVC.Structure(...)  Ribbon: Analysis » ADVC » Structure

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the job name of ADVC analysis. This name would be the name of analysis job in Assembly Tree and the name of the ADX file after exported.The default value is "".

title: strDescription​
content: A String specifying the description for ADVC analysis job. The description would write in the ADX file, where contents will be written below ModelInfo.The default value is "".

title: crlProcessSequence​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of ADVC process sequence. This argument controls the Process solution type and its setting information depended on solution type.The default value is [].

title: crlElemLocationGroup​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of element location. The model contains element group such as 3D Element, 2D Element, 1D Element to use this argument.The default value is [].

title: crlNodeLocationGroup​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of node location. The model contains node group to use this argument.The default value is [].

title: bWriteGroup​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the write group option which output a selected group of faces, elements, nodes as Surface Segment, Element Set and Node set respectively. If True, ADX file would contained group information such as Part, Face, Element(3D,2D,1D), Node,...If False, ADX won't write group information. The default value is False.

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing ADVC job in Assembly Tree to modify it. If this parameter is used, the specified ADVC job will be modified. If it is left None, a new ADVC job will be created.The default value is None.

title: bResultReference​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the Result Reference option is defined or not. If True, this option will allow to active settings of Result Reference. The settings of Result Reference arguments will be valid to use.If False, this option will be disable settings of Result Reference. In this case, the settings of Result Reference arguments will be ignored even though User has set value or not. The default value is False.

title: iSeparateFile​
content: An Integer specifying the separate file type. This option allows to separate information into many exported ADX files by selected type. If iSeparateFile=0: None, this option would export only 1 ADX file contains all information of all bodies/parts in the model (ModelInfo, Unit, Geometry, LBCs, Process Sequence,...)If iSeparateFile=1: By Model, this option would export 2 ADX files, which the first ADX file has same name as analysis Job will contain general information (such as ModelInfo, Unit, LBCs, Job name, Process Sequence, other settings of ADVC Structure analysis). When the last one ADX file which has suffix name "_model", contains Geometry information (such as Node, Part, Element,...)If iSeparateFile=2: By Body, this option would export ADX files, which each body/part in model would be written individually Geometry information, Group in model would be written in another file, while other information would be written in the ADX file has same name as analysis Job.If iSeparateFile=3: By Selected Body, this option would export ADX file that write information of selected part/body. If selection does not have at least a specific body/part, Jupiter would write all bodies/part (same option as None).If iSeparateFile=4: By Selected LBCs, this option would export 1 ADX file contains LBCs information of the chosen LBCs. The default value is 0.

title: bExportRelatedAllLBCs​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that export all related Load Boundary Condition. This option could be used when iSeparateFile=3(By Selected Body), if not, this setting is not activated for both True or False. If True, this option would export the ADX file contains related information to LBCs such as Contact, Connection RBE, Bolt Pretension,...If False, this option won't export related information to LBCs such as Contact, Connection RBE, Bolt Pretension,... The default value is False.

title: bUseEntityName​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that use entity name in exported file or not. If True, this option would export the ADX file that write Entity name(Name of the Part/Entity) to Geometry information such as Part, Face,...If False, this option would export the ADX file without writing Entities name to Geometry information. The default value is False.

title: bMatrixSolverParam​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that the Matrix Solver Parameter is defined ot not. If True, this option will allow to active settings of Matrix Solver Parameter. The settings of Matrix Solver Parameter arguments will be valid to use.If False, this option will be disable settings of Matrix Solver Parameter. In this case, the settings of Matrix Solver Parameter arguments will be ignored even though User has set value or not. The default value is False.

title: iPreconditionType​
content: An Integer specifying the precondition type. If iPreconditionType=0: ScalingIf iPreconditionType=1: CGCGIf iPreconditionType=2: CGCG2If iPreconditionType=3: CGCG2_DiagIf iPreconditionType=4: CGCG2-SOR The default value is 0.

title: iMatrixStructure​
content: An Integer specifying the matrix structure type. If iMatrixStructure=0: SymmetryIf iMatrixStructure=1: Asymmetry The default value is 0.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of targets. The target could be Part or LBCs item.The default value is [].

title: iLoadType​
content: An Integer specifying the load type uses for analysis. If iLoadType=0: Load Case, which is a group of specific Loads, BCs applies on model. The model could apply many Load Cases which may have same setting of LBCs. Exporting ADX file would write all Load Cases.If iLoadType=1: Load, which will export the ADX file stores all Loads, BCs as a 1 Load case only. The default value is 1.

title: bSameOutputOnAllProcess​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the same output request for all processes. If True, this option would set same output request (Displacement, Stress, Strain,...) for all defined processes.If False, this option would set output request which will base on user's desired result for each process. The default value is True.

title: bDeleteFloatingNode​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that would delete floating node or not. If True, this option would export an ADX file without writing floating nodes information.If False, this option would export an ADX file with floating nodes information. The default value is True.

title: bBC​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that would separate boundary condition. This option could be used when iSeparateFile=3 (By Selected Body), if not, this setting is not activated for both True or False. If True, this option would export an ADX file would write LBCs information.If False, this option won't export an ADX file would write LBCs information. The default value is True.

title: bCheckBCDuplicate​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable checking whether boundary conditions are duplicated or not. If True, this option checks LBCs duplication when export the ADX file.If False, this option won't check LBCs duplication when export the ADX file. The default value is False.

title: bAutoAssignDummyProp​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable automatically assign dummy property option. This option used when model that has not assign property yet. If the model already has property If True, the model would be exported with dummy property for the Part that does not have property. The others Part (which already assigned property) will export with its property setting.If False, the model will export ADX file in case of the model has all property in all Parts, but if there is one Part that does not have property in the model, this option will not export file. The default value is False.

title: crDummyPropMaterial​
content: A Cursor specifying the dummy property material for automatically assigning dummy property when export the ADX file.The default value is None.

title: bReferenceRestartData​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the Reference Restart Data is defined or not. If True, this option will allow to active settings of Reference Restart Data. The settings of Reference Restart Data arguments will be valid to use.If False, this option will be disable settings of Reference Restart Data. In this case, the settings of Reference Restart Data arguments will be ignored even though User has set value or not. The default value is False.

title: strReferenceRestartDataPath​
content: A String specifying the path of Reference Restart Data.The default value is "".

title: iReferenceRestartDataProcessNum​
content: An Integer specifying the number of process for Reference Restart Data.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iReferenceRestartDataStepNum​
content: An Integer specifying the number of Reference Restart Data step.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iReferenceRestartDataCoordType​
content: An Integer specifying the coordinate type of Reference Restart Data. If iReferenceRestartDataCoordType=0: Initial typeIf iReferenceRestartDataCoordType=1: Deformation type The default value is 0.

title: iReferenceRestartDataUpdateContactSearch​
content: An Integer specifying the update contact search for Reference Restart Data. If iReferenceRestartDataUpdateContactSearch=0: NoIf iReferenceRestartDataUpdateContactSearch=1: Yes The default value is 1.

title: listLoadNodeContact​
content: A LOAD_NODE_CONTACT List specifying the list of load node contact.The default value is [].

title: bCreateProcessForBoltFixedLength​
content: A Boolean specifying the option that creates process for bolt fixed length. If True, this option will set the "Bolt Fixed Length" given in the initial process to hold in the next process.If False, this option will won't take the "Bolt Fixed Length" setting in the initial process to apply on the next process. This setting uses the character string "BoltLoadFixedLength".The default value is False.

title: strPath​
content: A String specifying the exporting path for the ADX file.This is a required input.

title: iNumType​
content: An Integer specifying the numeric format type. This argument would allow numeric setting type of the ADX file. If iNumType=0: Real Type - The numerical values in real number format (123.456).If iNumType=1: Power Type - The numerical values in exponential/scientific format (1.234E-005). The default value is 0.

title: iUiWidth​
content: An Integer specifying the limitation number of digits before the point of the number. This option allows to control number digits of value in the exported ADX file.The default value is 10.

title: iUiPrecision​
content: An Integer specifying the limitation number of digits after the point of the number. This option allows to control number digits of value in the exported ADX file.The default value is 1.

title: bExportGeometryID​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the write geometry ID number.The default value is False.

title: bSeparatePartInfoFile​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that separate Part Information Files.The default value is False.

title: strADVCTemplateFilePath​
content: A String specifying the path of Template File.The default value is "".

title: bOutputDefinition​
content: A Boolean specifying to be enable/disable the option that sets the output request.The default value is True.

title: iDataFormatType​
content: An Integer specifying the data format type.

title: iEJobType​
content: An Integer specifying the job type (Structure = 0)

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the force setting.The default value is "ForceNormal1".

title: dForce​
content: A Double specifying the total force value (default unit: N).The default value is 0.

title: crElemForNormal​
content: A Cursor specifying a 2D element. This element will be used to calculate vector normal for force direction.

title: iArrowDir​
content: An Integer specifying the display arrow direction. This parameter only affects the display of the force setting, the force itself remains intact. The value for this parameter is one of the following. 0: Start at node.1: End at node. The default value is 0.

title: iDistributeType​
content: An Integer specifying the force distribution method. The value for this parameter is one of the following. 0: Per selected entity. Each selected item (Face, Edge, Node) receives the same amount of the specified force. For example, a vector force [1; 0; 2] is applied on 2 faces, then each face will receive a vector force [1; 0; 2].1: Per selected node. Each nodes in selected items (Face, Edge, Node) receives the same amount of the specified force. For example, a vector force [1; 0; 2] is applied on 1 edge, which has 10 nodes, then each node will receive a vector force [1; 0; 2].2: Total of selected entity. Each selected item (Face, Edge, Node) receives the same amount of force, which is the specified force divided by the number of selected entity. For example, a vector force [1; 0; 2] is applied on 2 faces, then each face will receive a vector force [0.5; 0; 1]. The default value is 0.

title: crCoord​
content: A Cursor specifying the coordinate from which the fixed constraint is created.The default value is None(global coordinate system).

title: crlTargets​

title: crEdit​

title: Description​

title: Syntax​

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the new Boundary Condition name.The default value is "SubmodelForcedDisplacement1".

title: iSolver​
content: An Integer specifying the applied Solver. Possible value is 0 corresponding to ADVC solver.The default value is 0.

content: A String specifying the data directory name of the global model containing the model, result, and restart. It can be specified as either an absolute path or a relative path.The default value is "/home/".

title: iProcessNo​
content: An Integer specifying the process number.The default value is 0.

title: bMapX​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to map the X translational degree of freedom.The default value is True.

title: bMapY​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to map the Y translational degree of freedom.The default value is True.

title: bMapZ​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to map the Z translational degree of freedom.The default value is True.

title: iReferType​
content: An Integer specifying the reference destination for the result directory of the global model. 0: Not specified - Refers to the normal output result (dir name / result)1: Result - Refer to the normal output result (dir name / result)2: Restart - Refer to the restart output result (dir name / restart) The default value is 0.

title: dExtensionRange​
content: A Double specifying the extension of the range in the global coordinate system. Extend the search range by range in the global coordinate system.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dExtensionTol​
content: A Double specifying the extension of the range in the element coordinate system. Extend the search range by tolerance in the element coordinate system. If specified value smaller than dExtensionLimitTol, the extension parameter in the element coordinate system is dExtensionLimitTol.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dExtensionLimitTol​
content: A Double specifying the Newton-Raphson iteration convergence tolerance for calculating the "global coordinates corresponding to the submodel".The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: strGlobalElementSet​
content: A String specifying the element group name of the "global element containing submodel" that is known in advance.The default value is "".

title: iUseBucket​
content: An Integer specifying whether to use the bucket method to speed up the search. 0: Not specified - Use the bucket method1: Yes - Use the bucket method2: No - Do not use the bucket method The default value is 0.

title: iNumBucketMaxX​
content: An Integer specifying the maximum number of bucket divisions in the x-direction.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iNumBucketMaxY​
content: An Integer specifying the maximum number of bucket divisions in the y-direction.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iNumBucketMaxZ​
content: An Integer specifying the maximum number of bucket divisions in the z-direction.The default value is DFLT_INT.

title: iPrevBc​
content: An Integer specifying the specified boundary condition to maintain. 0: Not specified1: Default Hold The default value is 0.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the targets to be applied. The target can be Face entities or Node entities. The crlTargets and crForcedDispBC arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is [].

title: crForcedDispBC​
content: A Cursor specifying the existing Boundary Condition (Forced Displacement). If this argument is not None, the specified Boundary Condition will be modified. Otherwise, a new Boundary Condition will be created. The crlTargets and crForcedDispBC arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created LBC.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() created_bcs = BoundaryConditions.Submodel.ForcedDisplacement(crlTargets=[Face(26)]) JPT.Debugger(created_bcs)

title: Description​
content: Create connectors between nodes, edges, and faces according to specified connection types. User selects master/slave targets and the connectors will be created to connect nodes on master/slave targets with each other.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.Connector(...)  Macro: Connector Ribbon: Connections » Connector

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the connection name to be created.The default value is "Connector_1".

title: iMethod​
content: An Integer specifying the connection method. If iMethod=1, the method is Node to Node.If iMethod=2, the method is Edge to Edge.If iMethod=3, the method is Face to Face. The default value is 1.

title: iConnectType​
content: An Integer specifying the connection type. If iConnectType=0, the connection type is Parallel.If iConnectType=1, the connection type is Translation. If iConnectType=2, the connection type is Rotation.If iConnectType=3, the connection type is Bushing.If iConnectType=4, the connection type is Cylindrical.If iConnectType=5, the connection type is Joint.If iConnectType=6, the connection type is RigidRod.If iConnectType=7, the connection type is RigidBar. The default value is 0.

title: iRefNode​
content: An Integer specifying a node to refer to when determining the coordinate system. If iRefNode=0, reference to the first node.If iRefNode=1, reference to the second node. The default value is 0.

title: iElemCs​
content: An Integer specifying the option whether or not an element coordinate system is used. If iElemCs=0, do not use element coordinate system.If iElemCs=1, use element coordinate system. The default value is 0.

title: crLocalCS​
content: A Cursor specifying the local coordinate system.The default value is None.

title: crlElasticity​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the table data of elastic property.The default value is [].

title: crlDamp​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the table data of viscosity characteristics.The default value is [].

title: crlMasterTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of master targets. The targets are nodes when the iMethod is equal to 1.The targets are edges when the iMethod is equal to 2.And the targets are faces when the iMethod is equal to 3. The default value is [].

title: crlSlaveTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of slave targets. The targets are nodes when the iMethod is equal to 1.The targets are edges when the iMethod is equal to 2.And the targets are faces when the iMethod is equal to 3. The default value is [].

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing connection. If this parameter is used, the specified connection will be modified. If it is left None, a new connection will be created. The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created contact.

title: Description​
content: Define the contact set between the specified group for Abaqus. Create a group with master and slave surfaces beforehand to define the contact in the contact settings.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.Contacts.Abaqus.ManualGroup(...)  Ribbon: Connections » Contacts » Abaqus » Manual Group

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the new Abaqus Contact name.The default value is "ContactAbaqus_1".

title: iContactType​
content: An Integer specifying the behavior type of contact definition. The behavior type of contact definition is one of the following: 0: General (Sliding Contact)1: Tied (Shell-Solid contact)2: All with self - Automatic contact detection The default value is 0.

title: iContactAlgorithm​
content: An Integer specifying the contact setting target entity. 0: Face to Face - Contact between shell or solid element faces and shell or solid element faces.1: Node to Face - Contact between node and shell or solid element faces. The default value is 0.

title: dAdjustWidth​
content: A Double specifying a value to adjust the initial positions of the surfaces specified. This is required when the iTied parameter is used with ON value. This argument is used only when iContactType=0.The default value is 0.0.

title: dExtensionZone​
content: A Double specifying a value that is equal to a fraction of the end segment or facet edge length by which Abaqus extends the master surface to avoid numerical round-off errors associated with contact modeling. The value given must lie between 0.0 and 0.2. This parameter affects only node-to-surface contact. This argument is used only when iContactType=0.The default value is 0.0.

title: dMaxPenetration​
content: A Double specifying the maximum distance by which a point on the slave surface must penetrate the master surface before Abaqus abandons the current increment and tries again with a smaller increment. This parameter does not apply to contact pairs that use the finite-sliding, surface-to-surface contact formulation. This argument is used only when iContactType=0.The default value is 0.0.

title: iSmallSliding​
content: An Integer specifying whether to use the small-sliding contact formulation. This parameter is not allowed with self-contact. This argument is used only when iContactType=0. 0: OFF1: ON The default value is 0.

title: dSmoothAngle​
content: A Double specifying the degree of smoothing used for element-based master surfaces in the finite-sliding, node-to-surface contact formulation. The value given must lie between 0.0 and 0.5. This parameter does not affect contact pairs with analytical rigid surfaces or contact formulations other than the finite-sliding, node-to-surface contact formulation. This argument is used only when iContactType=0.The default value is 0.0.

title: iFrictionType​
content: An Integer specifying the friction characteristics type. This argument is used only when iContactType=0. 0: None1: General2: Lagrange3: Rough4: Static & Kinetic The default value is 0.

title: dFrictionCoeff1​
content: A Double specifying the first friction coefficient to be defined in terms of slip rate. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=1 or iFrictionType=2.The default value is 0.0.

title: dFrictionCoeff2​
content: A Double specifying the second friction coefficient to be defined in terms of slip rate. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=1 or iFrictionType=2.The default value is 0.0.

title: dShearStressLimit​
content: A Double specifying an optional equivalent shear stress limit, so that regardless of the magnitude of the contact pressure stress, sliding will occur if the magnitude of the equivalent shear stress reaches this value. A value of zero is not allowed. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=1 or iFrictionType=2.The default value is 0.0.

title: dSlipTolerance​
content: A Double specifying the maximum allowable elastic slip for surface dimension ratio. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=1 or iFrictionType=4.The default value is 0.0.

title: dStaticFrictionCoeff​
content: A Double specifying the static friction coefficient. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=4.The default value is 0.0.

title: dKineticFrictionCoeff​
content: A Double specifying the dynamic friction coefficient. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=4.The default value is 0.0.

title: dDecayCoeff​
content: A Double specifying the decay coefficient. This argument is used only when iFrictionType=4.The default value is 0.0.

title: bAdjustPosition​
content: An Integer specifying whether to adjust the position of surfaces in the contact pair. This argument is used only when iContactType=1.The default value is False.

title: dPositionTolerance​
content: A Double specifying the tolerance of position of surfaces used for adjustment. This argument is used only when bAdjustPosition=1.The default value is 0.0.

title: iFormulationType​
content: An Integer specifying how Abaqus generates the contact constraint coefficients. This argument is used only when iContactType=0. 0: Node to Surface1: Surface to Surface The default value is 0.

title: iTied​
content: An Integer specifying whether the surfaces in the contact pair are to be tied together for the duration of the analysis. This argument is used only when iContactType=0. 0: Not specified - Not want to tie the surfaces together.1: ON - Tie the surfaces together. The default value is 0.

title: iPressureOverclosureType​
content: An Integer specifying a contact pressure-overclosure relationship. 0: Hard Contact - Pressure-overclosure relationship without physical softening.1: Exponential - Exponential pressure-overclosure relationship.2: Linear - Linear pressure-overclosure relationship.3: Tabular - Piecewise linear pressure-overclosure relationship in tabular form.4: None The default value is 0.

title: bAllowSeparation​
content: An Integer specifying whether to allow separation of the two surfaces once contact has been established. This argument is used when iPressureOverclosureType=0.The default value is False.

title: dContactStiffness​
content: A Double specifying the slope of the pressure-overclosure curve. This value must be positive and is required when iPressureOverclosureType=2.The default value is 0.0.

title: tshPressureOverclosure​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the tabular data of Pressure-Overclosure used for exponential pressure-overclosure relationship. This argument must be specified when iPressureOverclosureType=1 or iPressureOverclosureType=3.The default value is [].

title: iThermalConductanceDef​
content: An Integer specifying the contact characteristic definition method of heat conduction. 0: None1: Clearance Dependency2: Pressure Dependency3: Clearance & Pressure Dependency The default value is 0.

title: bClearanceTemperatureDependency​
content: A Boolean specifying whether the tabular data have Temperature-Dependent property.The default value is False.

title: iClearanceDependencies​
content: An Integer specifying the number of field variables in the data table. This argument must be specified when iThermalConductanceDef=1 or iThermalConductanceDef=3.The default value is 0.

title: tshClearanceData​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the tabular data of clearance dependency.The default value is [].

title: bPressureTemperatureDependency​
content: A Boolean enable/disable using temperature dependency data.The default value is False.

title: iPressureDependencies​
content: An Integer specifying number of the field variables.The default value is 0.

title: tshPressureData​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the table of pressure dependency.The default value is [].

title: crplTargets​
content: A List of Pair of Cursor specifying the list or pair of group master face and group slave face. The crplTargets and crContactAbaqus arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is [].

title: crContactAbaqus​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing Abaqus Contact (Manual Group). If this parameter is used, the specified contact settings will be modified. Otherwise, a new contact settings will be created. The crplTargets and crContactAbaqus arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is None.

title: iContactColor​
content: An Integer specifying the contact color.The default value is 0.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created contact.

title: Description​
content: Define contact settings between specified faces for the Abaqus solver.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.Contacts.Abaqus.ManualFace(...)  Ribbon: Connections » Contacts » Abaqus » ManualFace

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the contact name.The default value is "ContactAbaqus_1".

title: iContactAlgorithm​
content: An Integer specifying the type of contact connection. 0: Face to Face - Contact between shell or solid element faces and shell or solid element faces.1: Node to Face - Contact between node and shell or solid element faces. The default value is 0.

title: iContactType​
content: An Integer specifying the behavior type of contact definition. The behavior type of contact definition is one of the following. 0: General Type (Sliding Contact)1: Tied Type (Shell-Solid contact)2: All with self Type The default value is 0.

title: iAlg​
content: An Integer specifying the contact setting target entity.The default value is 0.

title: dAdjustVal​
content: A Double specifying the adjustment width of the initial node position.The default value is 0.0.

title: dExtensionZone​
content: A Double specifying the extended area.The default value is 0.0.

title: dMaxPenetration​
content: A Double specifying the maximum penetration distance value.The default value is 0.0.

title: iSmallSliding​
content: An Integer specifying the consideration of small-slip. 0: OFF1: ON The default value is 0.

title: dSmooth​
content: A Double specifying the smoothing angle.The default value is 0.0.

title: iFrictionType​
content: An Integer specifying the friction characteristics type. The friction characteristics type is one of the following. 0: None1: General2: Lagrange3: Rough4: Static & Kinetic The default value is 0.

title: dFrictionCoef1​
content: A Double specifying the friction coefficient 1 when Friction type is set as General or Lagrange.The default value is 0.0.

title: dFrictionCoef2​
content: A Double specifying the friction coefficient 2 when Friction type is set as General or Lagrange.The default value is 0.0.

title: dShearLimit​
content: A Double specifying the Shear stress limit when Friction type is set as General or Lagrange.The default value is 0.0.

title: dSlipTol​
content: A Double specifying the maximum allowable elastic slip for surface dimension ratio when Friction type is set as General or Static & Kinetic.The default value is 0.0.

title: dStaticFrictionCoef​
content: A Double specifying the Coefficient of static friction when Friction type is set as Static & Kinetic.The default value is 0.0.

title: dKineticFrictionCoef​
content: A Double specifying the Coefficient of dynamic friction when Friction type is set as Static & Kinetic.The default value is 0.0.

title: dDecayCoef​
content: A Double specifying the Reduction factor when Friction type is set as Static & Kinetic.The default value is 0.0.

title: iAdjust​
content: An Integer specifying the consideration of adjustment.The default value is 0.

title: dPositionTol​
content: A Double specifying the position tolerance value.The default value is 0.0.

title: iFormula​
content: An Integer specifying the contact formulation type. 0: Node to Surface1: Surface to Surface The default value is 0.

title: iTie​
content: An Integer specifying the fixed conditions and contact pair.The default value is 0.

title: iPOCType​
content: An Integer specifying the Contact thickness of the contact direction behavior, to define the penetration characteristics type.The default value is 0.

title: iAllowSeparation​
content: An Integer specifying the separation option when pressure-overclosure type is set as Hard Contact.The default value is 0.

title: dSlope​
content: A Double specifying the contact stiffness when pressure-overclosure type is set as Linear.The default value is 0.0.

title: tshPOCTsheet​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the table of pressure-Overclosure when pressure-overclosure type is set as Exponential.The default value is [].

title: iClearanceType​
content: An Integer specifying the contact characteristic definition method of heat conduction. 0: None1: Clearance Dependency2: Pressure Dependency3: Clearance & Pressure Dependency The default value is 0.

title: iClearanceTypeId​
content: An Integer specifying the clearance dependency type ID.The default value is 0.

title: bTemperatureDependency​
content: A Boolean enable/disable using temperature dependency data.The default value is False.

title: iDependencies​
content: An Integer specifying number of the field variables.The default value is 0.

title: tshCDTsheet​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the table of clearance dependency.The default value is [].

title: iPrsTypeId​
content: An Integer specifying the pressure dependency type ID.The default value is 0.

title: bPrsTemperatureDependency​
content: A Boolean enable/disable using temperature dependency data.The default value is False.

title: iPrsDependencies​
content: An Integer specifying number of the field variables.The default value is 0.

title: tshPrsDTsheet​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the table of pressure dependency.The default value is [].

title: crplTargets​
content: A Cursor Pair List specifying the list or pair of group master face and group slave face.The default value is [].

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing contact settings item. If this parameter is used, the specified contact settings item will be modified. If it is left None, a new contact settings item will be created.The default value is None.

title: iColor​
content: An Integer specifying the contact color.The default value is 0.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created contact.

content: Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=15132254) Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[0.011, 0.0, 0.0], strName="Cube_2", iPartColor=6013120) Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[0.011, 0.01, 0.0], strName="Cube_3", iPartColor=5395146) Tools.Group.CreateGroup(strGroupName="Group1", crlTargets=[Face(73)]) Tools.Group.CreateGroup(strGroupName="Group2", crlTargets=[Face(48)]) Assembly.RightClick.Rename(strNewName="Master", crItem=Group(1)) Assembly.RightClick.Rename(strNewName="Slave", crItem=Group(2)) Meshing.SolidMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1, 2, 3)], bTet10=True, dGradingFactor=1.05, dStretchLimit=0.1, iSpeedVsQual=1, iRegion=1, bSafeMode=False, iParallel=12, bInternalMeshOnly=False, iPartColor=65280) Tools.Group.CreateGroup(strGroupName="ContactAbaqus_1_Manual_Face_M", crlTargets=[Face(24)]) Tools.Group.CreateGroup(strGroupName="ContactAbaqus_1_Manual_Face_S", crlTargets=[Face(49)]) # Create face contact (Abaqus) creating_status = Connections.Contacts.Abaqus.ManualFace(strName="ContactAbaqus_1", dAdjustWidth=0.01, dExtensionZone=DFLT_DBL, dMaxPenetration=DFLT_DBL, iSmallSliding=1, dSmoothAngle=DFLT_DBL, iFrictionType=1, dFrictionCoeff1=0.015, dFrictionCoeff2=DFLT_DBL, dShearStressLimit=DFLT_DBL, dSlipTolerance=DFLT_DBL, dStaticFrictionCoeff=DFLT_DBL, dKineticFrictionCoeff=DFLT_DBL, dDecayCoeff=DFLT_DBL, bAdjustPosition=True, dPositionTolerance=DFLT_DBL, dContactStiffness=DFLT_DBL, tshPressureOverclosure=[0, 0], tshClearanceData=[1, 2, DFLT_DBL, DFLT_DBL], tshPressureData=[1, 2, DFLT_DBL, DFLT_DBL], crplTargets=[CursorPair(Group(3), Group(4))], iContactColor=16711680) JPT.Debugger(creating_status)

title: Description​
content: Define contact settings between specified faces for the ADVC solver.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.Contacts.ADVC.ManualFace(...)  Ribbon: Connections » Contacts » ADVC » ManualFace

title: crlMasterFaces​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the master faces.This is the required input.

title: crlSlaveFaces​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the slave faces.This is the required input.

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the contact name.The default value is "ContactADVC".

title: iContactType​
content: An Integer specifying the behavior type of the contact definition. The behavior type of contact definition is one of the following. 0: General Type (Sliding Contact)1: Tied Type (Shell-Solid contact) The default value is 0.

title: iSlidingType​
content: An Integer specifying the sliding type. 0: Blank.1: Finite sliding.2: Small sliding.3: Not sliding. The default value is 0.

title: iInitialState​
content: An Integer specifying the initial contact state. 0: Blank.1: Auto - Auto-detect.2: Open - Start analysis from the non-contact state3: Close - Start analysis from the contact state . The default value is 0.

title: dInitialStateTol​
content: A Double specifying the the tolerance value to determine the initial contact state.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dKineticFrictionCoef​
content: A Double specifying the dynamic coefficient of friction.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dExponentialCoef​
content: A Double specifying the exponential damping coefficient.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iBehavior​
content: An Integer specifying the the presence or absence of contact. 0: Separation - Remove the contact restraint when the tensile force is generated.1: No Separation - Binding on all of the contact pairs that were found at the beginning of the contact search. The default value is 0.

title: dClearance​
content: A Double specifying the clearance amount.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iAdjustToClearance​
content: An Integer specifying whether or not avoid the collapse element in accordance with node movement by Adjust function. This argument is active when iSlidingType=0 or iSlidingType=2. 0: Blank.1: Yes.2: No. The default value is 0.

title: dInterference​
content: A Double specifying the interference.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iAdjustToInterference​
content: An Integer specifying whether or not adjust to interference. This argument is active when iSlidingType=1 or iSlidingType=3. 0: Blank.1: Yes.2: No. The default value is 0.

title: iAutoShrink​
content: An Integer specifying the presence or absence of penetration elimination. 0: Blank.1: Yes.2: No. The default value is 0.

title: iAdjust​
content: An Integer specifying the whether or not move the slave node on the master surface so that the clearance goes to zero. 0: Blank.1: Yes - Move all of the slave node.2: Value - Defines the distance to enable the node movement. The default value is 0.

title: dAdjustValue​
content: A Double specifying the distance to enable the node movement.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dFrictionCoef​
content: A Double specifying the coefficient of static friction.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dMaxShear​
content: A Double specifying the maximum shear stress.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dElasticSlip​
content: A Double specifying the allowable amount of slip.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dSlipTolerance​
content: A Double specifying the allowable slip tolerance.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dSearchWidth​
content: A Double specifying the inside and outside determination parameter in the direction of the contact surface.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dSearchGap​
content: A Double specifying the normal direction search distance for the gap surface.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dSearchDepth​
content: A Double specifying the the normal direction search distance for the penetration surface.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dCriticalPenetration​
content: A Double specifying the critical penetration amount.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iEstimationImpactTime​
content: An Integer specifying the contact pairs using prediction of collision and release time. 0: Blank.1: Yes.2: No. The default value is 0.

title: iFormula​
content: An Integer specifying the contact formulation type. 0: Blank.1: Node to Segment: Node - Face contact2: Segment to Segment: Face - Face contact. The default value is 0.

title: iConstraintType​
content: An Integer specifying the contact constraint type. 0: Blank.1: Lagrange - Lagrange undetermined multiplier method.2: Penalty - Penalty method. The default value is 0.

title: iThermalDataType​
content: An Integer specifying the heat transfer coefficient of clearance dependency. 0: Blank.1: Clearance Dependency - Define the heat transfer coefficient of the clearance dependency.2: Conductivity - Coefficient of heat transfer.3: Clearance - Clearance The default value is 0.

title: iTypeId​
content: An Integer specifying the type ID. 0: CLEARANCE_DEPENDENCY.1: PRESSURE_DEPENDENCY. The default value is 0.

title: bTemperatureDependency​
content: A Boolean specifying whether or not using temperature dependency data .The default value is False.

title: iNumDependencies​
content: An Integer specifying the number of dependencies.The default value is 0.

title: tshTableClearance​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the table of clearance dependency.The default value is [].

title: bStabilized​
content: A Boolean specifying whether or not stabilization parameter is defined.The default value is 0.

title: iStabilizeType​
content: An Integer specifying the type of contact stabilization coefficient. 0: Blank.1: Stiffness - Stiffness ratio.2: Area - Area ratio. The default value is 0.

title: dResidualFactor​
content: A Double specifying the residual factor used to define the correction coefficient C1.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dEffectiveDist​
content: A Double specifying the effective distance that is used to define the correction coefficient C2.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dCN​
content: A Double specifying the normal direction stabilization coefficient.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dCT​
content: A Double specifying the tangential direction stabilization coefficient.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: crlClearances​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of clearances data.The default value is [].

title: crContactADVC​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing contact settings item. If this parameter is used, the specified contact settings item will be modified. If it is left None, a new contact settings item will be created.The default value is None.

title: dSearchAngle​
content: A Double specifying the search angle of normal vector of the master/slave surfaceThe default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iConstraintTypeExplicit​
content: An Integer specifying the contact constraint type in the explicit dynamic analysis. 0: Blank.1: Kinematic: Constraint method.2: Penalty: Penalty method. The default value is 0.

title: dPenaltyFact​
content: A Double specifying the the penalty scale factor.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dPenaltyFactExplicit​
content: A Double specifying the penalty scale factor in the explicit dynamic analysis.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iColor​
content: An Integer specifying the contact color.The default value is 16711680.

title: iAlgorithm​
content: An Integer specifying the contact setting target entity. 0: Face to Face The default value is 0.

title: iMethod​
content: An Integer specifying the method type. 0: MANUAL_FACE.1: MANUAL_GROUP.2: BY_GROUP_MATRIX.3: SHARE_FACE.4: AUTO_SETTING. The default value is 0.

title: bPressureTemperatureDependency​
content: A Boolean specifying whether or not using pressure temperature dependency data .The default value is False.

title: iPressureDependencies​
content: An Integer specifying the number of pressure dependencies.The default value is 0.

title: tshPressureData​
content: A Table Sheet specifying the table of pressure dependency.The default value is [].

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created contact.

content: Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=12537679) Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[0.01, 0.0, 0.0], strName="Cube_2", iPartColor=6250449) created_contact = Connections.Contacts.ADVC.ManualFace(crlMasterFaces=[Face(24)], crlSlaveFaces=[Face(49)], strName="ContactADVC1", iInitialState=1, dInitialStateTol=1.0, dKineticFrictionCoef=1.0, dExponentialCoef=1.0, iBehavior=1, iAdjustToClearance=2, dInterference=2.0, iAdjustToInterference=1, iAdjust=2, dFrictionCoef=1.0, dMaxShear=1.0, dElasticSlip=1.0, dSlipTolerance=1.0, dSearchWidth=1.0, dSearchGap=1.0, dSearchDepth=1.0, dCriticalPenetration=1.0, iFormula=1, iThermalDataType=2, iTypeId=1, tshTableClearance=[1, 2, 0, 0], bStabilized=True, iStabilizeType=2, dSearchAngle=1.0, iConstraintTypeExplicit=2, dPenaltyFact=1.0, dPenaltyFactExplicit=1.0, tshPressureData=[1, 2, 0, 0]) JPT.Debugger(created_contact)

title: Description​
content: Export the contact report of the current model to html/excel format. This function allows modifying report settings such as picture control, sort, and filter.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.Contacts.ExportCheckReport(...)  Ribbon: Connections » Contacts » Export Check Report

title: strPath​
content: A String specifying the destination path of the HTML/Excel file to be exported. The destination path should be different from the C Drive (C:/) due to Window would deny saving any files to the C Drive directly (It is recommended to save in User's Drive such as D Drive, E Drive,...).This is a required input.

title: dZoomFactor​
content: A Double specifying the zoom factor when capturing the image. If the zoom factor is greater than 1, the captured model will become larger (zoom in).if the zoom factor is smaller than 1, the captured model will become smaller (zoom out). The default value is 1.2.

title: iFitBy​
content: An Integer specifying which entity type will be focused on when capturing the image. If iFitBy=0: Part - Fit to Part. The part contains Master/Slave face of contact will be focused on when capturing.If iFitBy=1: Face - Fit to Contact face. The face which is Master/Slave face of contact will be focused on when capturing. The default value is 0.

title: iListBy​
content: An Integer specifying the contact report will be listed by type. If iListBy=0: Part - List by Part: This option will list contacts in all parts of the model. The duplication of contacts is allowable.If iListBy=1: Contact Condition - List by contact condition: This option will list contacts by the existing contacts in the model, each contact will be declared only once a time. The duplication of contacts will not occur. The default value is 0.

title: iListOrder​
content: An Integer specifying the order sort type of contacts in report. If iListOther=0: Name - Sort Result by Name: This option will list contacts in the report by Alphabetical order (from A-Z).If iListOther=1: ID - Sort Result by identify number: This option will list contacts in the report by ID Numerical order (ascending order). The default value is 0.

title: iFormat​
content: An Integer specifying the file format type. If iFormat=0: the contact report will be exported by HTML format file.If iFormat=1: the contact report will be exported by Excel format file. The default value is 0.

title: Return Code​
content: A Boolean specifying whether the HTML file is exported correctly or not: True: The HTML file is exported correctly.False: The HTML file is exported correctly.

title: Description​
content: Define contact settings between specified faces for the NX Nastran solver.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.Contacts.NXNastran.ManualFace(...)  Ribbon: Connections » Contacts » NX Nastran » Manual Face

title: crlFaceMasters​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the faces to be the master faces.This is a required input.

title: crlFaceSlaves​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the faces to be the slave faces.This is a required input.

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the contact name.The default value is "ContactNXNastran_1".

title: iContactType​
content: An Integer specifying the behavior type of contact definition. If iContactType=0, sliding contact.If iContactType=1, tied contact. The default value is 0.

title: iContactAlgorithm​
content: An Integer specifying the type of contact connection. If iContactAlgorithm=0, contact between shell or solid element faces and shell or solid element faces. The default value is 0.

title: dNormalPenaltyFactor​
content: A Double specifying the penalty factor for the normal direction. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 10.

title: dTangentialPenaltyFactor​
content: A Double specifying the penalty factor for the tangential direction. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 1.

title: dForceConvergenceTol​
content: A Double designating the Contact Force convergence tolerance. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 0.01.

title: dMaxForceIteration​
content: A Double designating the maximum number of iterations for a force (inner) loop. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 10.

title: dMaxStatusIteration​
content: A Double designating the maximum number of iterations for a status (outer) loop. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 20.

title: dNumberOfChange​
content: A Double specifying the allowable number of contact changes. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 0.02.

title: dMinContactPercentage​
content: A Double specifying the minimum contact set percentage. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 100.

title: iShellThickness​
content: An Integer specifying whether to include shell thickness for plate elements. The gap between connection regions will be independent of plate element thickness if this option is turned off. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0. If iShellThickness=0, include half shell thickness as surface offset.If iShellThickness=1, does not include thickness offset. The default value is 0.

title: iContactStatus​
content: An Integer specifying the flag to indicate if the contact status for a specific sub-case is to start from the final status of the previous subcase. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0. If iContactStatus=0, starts from previous subcase.If iContactStatus=1, starts from initial state. The default value is 0.

title: iInitGapOrPenetration​
content: An Integer specifying how Nastran handles initial gap or penetration of the generated contact elements. This setting is particularly useful if some of your elements unintentionally penetrate each other and you do not wish to modify or rebuild your model. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0. If iInitGapOrPenetration=0, use the value calculated from the grid coordinates.If iInitGapOrPenetration=1, sets the penetration to zero for all contact elements.If iInitGapOrPenetration=2, sets the both penetration and gap to zero for all contact elements. The default value is 0.

title: iRegionRefine​
content: An Integer specifying whether or not the source region is refined. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0. If iRegionRefine=0, refines the source region based on target surface definition.If iRegionRefine=1, does not refine the source region based on target surface definition. The default value is 0.

title: iEvaluateOrder​
content: An Integer specifying the number of “Linear Contact Points” for a single element on the source region. If iEvaluateOrder=0, lowest order of points on source region.If iEvaluateOrder=1, medium order of points on source region.If iEvaluateOrder=2, highest order of points on source region. The default value is 1.

title: dMinSearchDist​
content: A Double specifying the minimum distance for searching the contact elements. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 0.

title: dMaxSearchDist​
content: A Double specifying the maximum distance for searching the contact elements. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 0.01.

title: dFrictionCoeff​
content: A Double specifying the static coefficient of friction for the contact pair. This argument is to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 0.

title: dSearchDist​
content: A Double specifying the search range. This argument is to be used if iContactType=1.The default value is 0.

title: dPenaltyFactor​
content: A Double specifying the penalty proportional coefficient. This argument is to be used if iContactType=1.The default value is 0.

title: iShellZOffset​
content: An Integer specifying whether the Z-Offset on shell elements should be included in the contact analysis. If iShellZOffset=0, Z offset of shells is included as surface offset.If iShellZOffset=1, Z offset of shells is NOT included as surface offset. The default value is 0.

title: iContactColor​
content: An Integer specifying the contact-to-display marker color.The default value is 0.

title: crContactNXNastran​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing contact setting (NX Nastran). If this parameter is used, the specified contact setting (NX Nastran) will be modified. Whe the default value is used, a new contact setting (NX Nastran) will be created.The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created contact.

content: A Double specifying the penalty factor for the tangential direction. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 1.

title: dForceConvergenceTol​
content: A Double designating the Contact Force convergence tolerance. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 0.01.

title: dMaxForceIteration​
content: A Double designating the maximum number of iterations for a force (inner) loop. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 10.

title: dMaxStatusIteration​
content: A Double designating the maximum number of iterations for a status (outer) loop. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 20.

title: dNumberOfChange​
content: A Double specifying the allowable number of contact changes. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 0.02.

title: dMinContactPercentage​
content: A Double specifying the minimum contact set percentage. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 100.

title: iShellThickness​
content: An Integer specifying whether to include shell thickness for plate elements. The gap between connection regions will be independent of plate element thickness if this option is turned off. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0. 0: Includes half shell thickness as surface offset.1: Does not include thickness offset. The default value is 0.

title: iContactStatus​
content: An Integer specifying the flag to indicate if the contact status for a specific sub-case is to start from the final status of the previous subcase. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0. 0: Starts from previous subcase.1: Starts from initial state. The default value is 0.

title: iInitGapOrPenetration​
content: An Integer specifying how Nastran handles initial gap or penetration of the generated contact elements. This setting is particularly useful if some of your elements unintentionally penetrate each other and you do not wish to modify or rebuild your model. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0. 0: Uses the value calculated from the grid coordinates.1: Sets the penetration to zero for all contact elements.2: Sets the both penetration and gap to zero for all contact elements. The default value is 0.

title: iRegionRefine​
content: An Integer specifying whether or not the source region is refined. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0. 0: Refines the source region based on target surface definition.1: Does not refine the source region based on target surface definition. The default value is 0.

title: iEvaluateOrder​
content: An Integer specifying the number of “Linear Contact Points” for a single element on the source region. 0: Lowest order of points on source region.1: Medium order of points on source region.2: Highest order of points on source region. The default value is 1.

title: dMinSearchDist​
content: A Double specifying the minimum distance for searching the contact elements. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 0.

title: dMaxSearchDist​
content: A Double specifying the maximum distance for searching the contact elements. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 0.01.

title: dFrictionCoef​
content: A Double specifying the static coefficient of friction for the contact pair. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=0.The default value is 0.

title: dSearchDist​
content: A Double specifying the search range. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=1.The default value is 0.

title: dPenaltyFactor​
content: A Double specifying the penalty proportional coefficient. This argument is available to be used if iContactType=1.The default value is 0.

title: iShellZOffset​
content: An Integer specifying whether the Z-Offset on shell elements should be included in the contact analysis. 0: Z offset of shells is included as surface offset.1: Z offset of shells is NOT included as surface offset. The default value is 0.

title: iContactColor​
content: An Integer specifying the contact-to-display marker color.The default value is 0.

title: crContactNXNastran​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing contact setting (NX Nastran). If this parameter is used, the specified contact setting (NX Nastran) will be modified. When the default value is used, a new contact setting (NX Nastran) will be created.The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created contact.

content: A Double specifying the gap distance in meters between parts to detect contact pairs.The default value is 0.001.

content: A String specifying the MPC name.The default value is "MPC_1".

title: Description​
content: Create a MPC connection between a slave node with multi-master nodes.

title: Syntax​

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the MPC name.The default value is "MPC_1".

title: crlMasterNodes​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of master nodes which need to be connected. The master nodes are the nodes from the second selected node onwards in the selection list of nodes.This is the required input.

title: crSlaveNode​
content: A Cursor specifying the slave node which needs to be connected. The slave node is the first selected node in the selection list of nodes. This slave node will connect to all master nodes.This is the required input.

content: A List of MPC_CONNECTION specifying the list of MPC connection.The default value is [].

title: dValue​
content: A Double specifying the MPC value.The default value is 0.0.

content: An Integer specifying the local coordinate system.The default value is 0.

title: bUpdateDispCS​
content: A Boolean specifying whether or not update displacement coordinate system. If True, the displacement coordinate system is updated.If False, displacement coordinate system is not updated. The default value is True.

title: crMPCConnection​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing MPC connection. If this parameter is used, the specified MPC connection will be modified.If it is left None, a new MPC connection will be created. The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created or the modified MPC connection.

title: Description​
content: Create MPC between selected nodes.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.MPC.General.NodesToNodes(...)  Macro: Mpc Ribbon: Connections » MPC » General » NodesToNodes

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the MPC name.The default value is "MPC_1".

title: crlMasterNodes​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of master nodes.In case this list has more than one selected node, the number of master nodes and slave nodes must be equal. The MPC is created by connecting selected master nodes with selected slave nodes one-to-one correspondingly.This is the required input.

title: crlSlaveNodes​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of slave nodes.In case this list has more than one selected node, the number of slave nodes and master nodes must be equal. The MPC is created by connecting selected master nodes with selected slave nodes correspondingly.This is the required input.

title: listMpcConnection​
content: A List of MPC_CONNECTION specifying the pair of MPC connection data type.The default value is [].

title: dSearchTol​
content: A Double specifying the MPC search tolerance value.The default value is 0.0.

title: dValue​
content: A Double specifying the MPC value.The default value is 0.0.

title: iMPCType​
content: An Integer specifying the MPC type. 0: MPC General.1: MPC Equation. The default value is 0.

title: iSearchType​
content: An Integer specifying the search type.The default value is 1.

title: iLocalCoordinate​
content: An Integer specifying the local coordinate system.The default value is 0.

title: bUpdateDispCS​
content: A Boolean specifying whether or not update displacement coordinate system. If True, the displacement coordinate system is updated.If False, displacement coordinate system is not updated. The default value is True.

title: crMPCConnection​
content: A Cursor specifying the exist MPC for editing. If this parameter is used, the specified exist MPC item will be modified.If it is left None, a new MPC item will be created. The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created or the modified MPC connection.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=7666683) Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[0.02, 0.0, 0.0], strName="Cube_2", iPartColor=12867524) created_mpc = Connections.MPC.General.NodesToNodes(strName="MPC_5", crlMasterNodes=[Node(760, 770)], crlSlaveNodes=[Node(323, 310)], listMpcConnection=[MPC_CONNECTION(dCoef=1.0, iDof=1), MPC_CONNECTION(dCoef=1.0, iDof=2), MPC_CONNECTION(dCoef=1.0, iDof=4), MPC_CONNECTION(), MPC_CONNECTION(), MPC_CONNECTION()], bUpdateDispCS=1) JPT.Debugger(created_mpc)

title: Description​
content: Create a MPC connection between slave nodes to master nodes one-to-one correspondingly. The sequence of nodes selection is the first master node, the first slave node, the second master node, the second slave node and so on.

title: Syntax​

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the MPC name.The default value is "MPC_1".

title: crlMasterNodes​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of master nodes which need to be connected. The master list can contain one or many nodes.In case the list has more than one face, the number of master nodes and slave nodes must be equal. The MPC is created by connecting the selected master nodes with the selected slave nodes one by one correspondingly.This is the required input.

title: crlSlaveNodes​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of slave nodes which need to be connected. The slave list can contain one or many nodes.In case the list has more than one face, the number of master nodes and slave nodes must be equal. The MPC is created by connecting the selected master nodes with the selected slave nodes one by one correspondingly.This is the required input.

title: listMpcConnection​
content: A List of MPC_CONNECTION specifying the list of MPC connection.The default value is [].

title: iLocalCoordinate​
content: An Integer specifying the local coordinate system.The default value is 0.

title: bUpdateDispCS​
content: A Boolean specifying whether or not update displacement coordinate system. If True, the displacement coordinate system is updated.If False, displacement coordinate system is not updated. The default value is True.

title: crMPCConnection​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing MPC connection. If this parameter is used, the specified MPC connection will be modified. If it is left None, a new MPC connection will be created. The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created or the modified MPC connection.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=7666683) Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[0.02, 0.0, 0.0], strName="Cube_2", iPartColor=12867524) created_mpc = Connections.MPC.General.TwoNodes(strName="MPC_10", crlMasterNodes=[Node(757)], crlSlaveNodes=[Node(347)], listMpcConnection=[MPC_CONNECTION(iDof=1), MPC_CONNECTION(iDof=2), MPC_CONNECTION(iDof=4), MPC_CONNECTION(), MPC_CONNECTION(), MPC_CONNECTION()], bUpdateDispCS=1) JPT.Debugger(created_mpc)

title: Description​
content: Create MPC between two faces.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.MPC.General.TwoFaces(...)  Macro: Mpc Ribbon: Connections » MPC » General » TwoFaces

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the MPC name.The default value is "MPC_1".

title: crMasterFace​
content: A Cursor specifying the master face. The couple crMasterFace, crSlaveFace and crMPCConnection arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is None.

title: crSlaveFace​
content: A Cursor specifying the slave face. The couple crMasterFace, crSlaveFace and crMPCConnection arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is None.

title: listMpcConnection​
content: A List of MPC_CONNECTION specifying the pair of MPC connection data type.The default value is [].

title: iLocalCoordinate​
content: An Integer specifying the local coordinate system.The default value is 0.

title: bUpdateDispCS​
content: A Boolean specifying whether or not update displacement coordinate system at nodes belongs to selected faces to the specified local coordinate system. If True, the displacement coordinate system is updated.If False, displacement coordinate system is not updated. The default value is True.

title: crMPCConnection​
content: A Cursor specifying the exist MPC for editing. The couple crMasterFace, crSlaveFace and crMPCConnection arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified. If this parameter is used, the specified exist MPC item will be modified. If it is left None, a new MPC item will be created. The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created or the modified MPC connection (2 Faces).

title: Description​
content: Create bolt pretension for the Abaqus solver.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.Pretension.Abaqus(...)  Macro: PretensionAbaqus Ribbon: Connections » Pretension » Abaqus

title: crTargets​
content: A Cursor specifying the faces or the element for creating the pretension force.This is a required input.

title: dForceValue​
content: A Double specifying the value of pretension force.This is a required input.

title: dlForceDirection​
content: A List of Double specifying the direction of pretension force.This is a required input.

title: dlControlNode​
content: A List of Double specifying the position of the control node.This is a required input.

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of pretension force.The default value is "PreTensionAbaqus1".

title: bFixedLength​
content: A Boolean specified whether or not the tightening force of the bolt option are retained.The default value is False.

content: A Cursor specifying the existing Fixed Constraint object of pretension force to be edited. This argument must be specified when crLbcPretensionAbaqus is specified. Otherwise, a new Fixed Constraint object will be created.The default value is None.

content: A Cursor specifying an existing pretension force (Abaqus). If no pretension force is specified, a new one will be created, otherwise, the specified pretension force (Abaqus) will be modified.The default value is None.

title: Description​
content: Define a rigid wall contact setting to simulate impact analyses with planar rigid walls.

title: Syntax​
content: Connections.RigidWall(...)  Ribbon: Connections » RigidWall

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the rigid wall name.The default value is "RigidWall1".

title: iObject​
content: An Integer specifying the rigid object type. 0: Planar rigid object. The default value is 0.

title: iType​
content: An Integer specifying the rigid wall type. 0: Infinite body.1: Finite body. The default value is 0.

title: iMotion​
content: An Integer specifying the behavior. 0: Static - Stationary.1: Moving - Movable. The default value is 0.

title: iFriction​
content: An Integer specifying the condition of friction types. The friction type of rigid wall contact definition is one of the following. 0: Frictionless - No friction.1: No Sliding - No slip.2: Coulomb Friction - Coulomb friction.3: Weld with Frictionless - Frictionless welding.4: Weld with No Sliding - Non-slip welding. The default value is 0.

title: iOrthoFriction​
content: An Integer specifying whether or not using rigid orthotropic frictional coefficient. 0: No1: Yes The default value is 0.

title: iForces​
content: An Integer specifying whether or not considering the reaction force. 0: No1: Yes The default value is 0.

title: dFinite1​
content: A Double specifying length of l(x) edge when Finite body is used.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dFinite2​
content: A Double specifying length of m(y) edge when Finite body is used.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dMotionMass​
content: A Double specifying the motion mass when Moving behavior is used.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dMotionInitVelocity​
content: A Double specifying the motion initial velocity Moving behavior is used.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dFricCoulombCoeff​
content: A Double specifying the friction coulomb coefficient when Coulomb Friction is used.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dFricWeldVelocity​
content: A Double specifying the critical normal velocity for weld when Frictionless welding is used.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iForcesCirclesNum​
content: An Integer specifying the number of forces cycles when reaction force is used.The default value is 0.

title: dOrthoStaticCoeff1​
content: A Double specifying the ortho static friction coefficient a when rigid Ortho is used.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dOrthoStaticCoeff2​
content: A Double specifying the ortho static friction coefficient b when rigid Ortho is used.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dOrthoDynamicCoeff1​
content: A Double specifying the ortho dynamic friction coefficient a when rigid Ortho is used.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dOrthoDynamicCoeff2​
content: A Double specifying the ortho dynamic friction coefficient b when rigid Ortho is used.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dOrthoDecayConst1​
content: A Double specifying the decay constant a-direction a.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dOrthoDecayConst2​
content: A Double specifying the decay constant a-direction b.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dOrthoFricVector1​
content: A Double specifying the ortho Friction Vector - x value.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dOrthoFricVector2​
content: A Double specifying the ortho Friction Vector - y value.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dOrthoFricVector3​
content: A Double specifying the ortho Friction Vector - z value.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: bAllNodeSlave​
content: A Boolean specifying whether or not considering all nodes to be subordinate points.The default value is False.

title: crCoord​
content: A Cursor specifying the local coordinate. If the crCoord does not specify any local coordinate, function will execute with global coordinate.The default value is None.

title: crAreaFaceSet​
content: A Cursor specifying the Selected Force Area Face when reaction force is used.The default value is None.

title: crVisualNodeSet​
content: A Cursor specifying the Selected Visualization Node Set when reaction force is used.The default value is None.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of targets will be set up as rigid wall.This is the required input.

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying an existing rigid wall contact setting. If this parameter is used, the specified rigid wall contact setting will be modified. When the default value is used, a new rigid wall contact setting will be created.The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created or the modified rigid wall contact connection.

content: Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=16053365) created_wall = Connections.RigidWall(crlTargets=[Face(24)]) JPT.Debugger(created_wall)

title: Description​
content: This method connects the given faces between assembly models of multiple shell parts.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.AdvancedShellAssembly(crlParts=[], crlFaces=[], iMeshType=0, bSelfIntersection=False, iMethod=3, dGapTol=2.1)  Ribbon: Geometry » Advanced Shell Assembly

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the parts to assemble. Either crlParts or crlFace must be specified.The default value is [].

title: crlFaces​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the faces to assemble. Either crlParts or crlFace must be specified.The default value is [].

title: iMeshType​
content: An Integer specifying the surrounding element type of the connecting region.If iMeshType=0, the mesh on the face is a triangular primary element.If iMeshType=1, the mesh on the face is a quadrilateral primary element. The mesh around the assembly edge will be re-meshed into a square mesh.The default value is 0.

title: bSelfIntersection​
content: A Boolean specifying whether or not the self-intersecting parts should be assembled.The default value is False.

title: iMethod​
content: An Integer specifying how to connect between faces.If iMethod=0, within the interval threshold, the free edge detects a portion not in contact with the face and stretches the free edge to the face to imprint and connect.If iMethod=1, connect the edges that exist within the interval threshold.If iMethod=2, detect face intersections and imprint the edges.If iMethod=3, the above three patterns are judged automatically. The assembly edges are imprinted and connected appropriately.The default value is 3.

title: dGapTol​
content: A Double specifying the distance to determine that the face and the edge, and the edge and the edge are connected.The default value is 2.1.

title: Return Code​
content: A String of 1 if success, or 0 if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=8124407) Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[0.01, 0.0, 0.0], strName="Cube_2", iPartColor=14441436) Geometry.AdvancedShellAssembly(crlParts=[Part(2, 1)])

title: Description​
content: Create a perpendicular line to the circular face on the curved face which can offset the imprinted line by specifying an angle value or an edge length value.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Edge.PerpendicularCylinderLine(...)  Macro: ImprintPerpendicularCylinderLineS Ribbon: Geometry » Edge » Perpendicular Cylinder Line

title: crlNodes​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the couple nodes, which the first node is the start node where the perpendicular line will be drawn, the second node is used to determine the offset direction (in case of user want to offset).This is a required input.

title: crlFaces​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the faces. The selected face could be curved surface or circular surface.This is a required input.

title: iMethod​
content: An Integer specifying the Imprint method. The method will be represented by the value according to order of selection in the combobox method. If iMethod=0: Center Angle - The angle at the cylindrical center of a perpendicular positionIf iMethod=1: Arc length - The distance on the circumference of a perpendicular position The default value is 0.

title: dOffset​
content: A Double specifying the offset value. The offset value would be an angle degrees or length of an arc of a circle in millimeters, which is depended on selection method.The default value is 0.0.

title: bOppositeSide​
content: A Boolean specifying whether the opposite side option is checked or not. This argument will allow to imprint 2 lines in both side of selected face. If True, Jupiter will create 2 lines in both sides of the curved surface of the cylinder. In case of the selection face is a circular face, the imprinted line will continuously go through the center node and cut the edge at a node that opposites to the start node.If False, Jupiter will create only 1 line that defined by start node. The default value is False.

title: bBreakFace​
content: A Boolean specifying whether the breaking face option is checked or not. If True, Jupiter will break faces after imprinted the perpendicular line on the selected face.If False, Jupiter won't break the target face after imprinted the perpendicular line. The default value is True.

title: Return Code​
content: A List of Cursor refers to the created edges.
