title: Description​
content: Create a face using the given edges as the face's boundaries. It will create a face by creating the geometry consisting of the underlying surface, associated edges, and vertices. The planar surfaces and smooth surfaces are switched by changing the related arguments.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Face.Edges(...)  Macro: CreateFaceFromEdges Ribbon: Geometry » Face » Edges

title: crlEdges​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the edges that bound the new face. Either crlEdges or crlNodes must be specified.

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying a given part to that the new face will belong.The default value is [].

title: crlNodes​
content: A List of Cursor specifying two nodes to define the direction in which the curved surface be created smoothly. If crlNodes is specified, the curved surface will be smoother than the face created by bound edges only.The default value is [].

title: bSharedFace​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to create a shared face when the given edges are shared edges.The default value is False.

title: bSmoothFace​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to create a smooth face instead of planar face.The default value is False.

title: bCreatePart​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to stitch the newly created face to the new part. If bSharedFace=True, this argument will be ignored.The default value is False.

title: bImproved​
content: A Boolean specifying whether the newly created face is created with smooth direction. This argument does not affect the operation if crlNodes is not specified.The default value is False.

title: bBarsOnly​
content: A Boolean indicating whether all of the selected edges are Bar part only.The default value is False.

title: bOnlyOnePart​
content: A Boolean indicating whether the newly created face is in the same new part. If bCreatePart=False, this argument will be ignored.The default value is True.

title: bIncludeMidNodes​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to include middle nodes when creating face.The default value is False.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the new face.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() created_face = Geometry.Face.Edges(crlEdges=[Edge(9, 19)]) JPT.Debugger(created_face)

title: Description​

content: An Integer specifying the specified type of Edges. title: Description​
content: Align the vertexes positions on the circles. Cylinder faces can also be split by 90 degree, for creating mapped mesh.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.FCircVertexAdjust(...)  Ribbon: Geometry » FCirc Vertex Adjust

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the parts whose vertices will be adjusted.The default value is [].

title: bFullCylinder​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to divide the full cylinder faces by 90 degree or not. If bFullCylinder=True, the cylindrical surfaces and torus surfaces in the selected parts will be divided into four locations at each 90 degree. This splitting makes it easier to create a mapped mesh.The default value is False.

title: bCylinderMoreThan90​

title: Description​
content: Create a cuboid body in a specific location. This relative location is computed to the specified local coordinate system.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube(...)  Macro: CreateCube Ribbon: Geometry ➡ Part ➡ Cube

title: dlOrigin​
content: A List of Double representing the X-, Y-, and Z-coordinates of the origin point.The default value is [0.0,0.0,0.0].

title: dlLength​
content: A List of Double specifying the cube length in meters in the X-, Y-, Z-axis direction.The default value is [0.01,0.01,0.01].

title: ilAxialNodes​
content: A List of Integer specifying the number of nodes along to each X-, Y-, Z-axis.The default value is [10,10,10].

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the newly created part.The default value is "Cube_1".

title: iPartColor​
content: An Integer specifying the color of the newly created part.The default value is 7105764.

title: crLocalCoordinate​
content: A Cursor specifying the local coordinate system.The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor of cube if success, or None if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: created_cube = Geometry.Part.Cube(dlOrigin=[0.005, 0.005, 0.005], strName="Cube_1", iPartColor=13259210) JPT.Debugger(created_cube)

title: Description​
content: Create a cylindrical body at a specific location. Its relative location is computed based on the specified local coordinate system.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Part.Cylinder(...)  Ribbon: Geometry » Part » Cylinder

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the newly created part.The default value is "Cylinder_1".

title: crLocalCoordinate​
content: A Cursor specifying the local coordinate system.The default value is None.

title: bHollow​
content: A Boolean specifying weather to hollow the created cylinder or not. If True, the cylinder will have a hollow at the center with radius defined by dTopInnerRadius and dBottomInnerRadius.If False, the cylinder will not have a hollow at the center. The default value is False.

title: bTapered​
content: A Boolean specifying weather to make the cylinder tapered (radius at two ends is different). If True, the cylinder will be tapered with radius defined by dBottomOuterRadius.If False, the cylinder will not be tapered. The default value is False.

title: dlOrigin​
content: A List of Double representing the X-, Y-, and Z-coordinates of the center of the cylinder.The default value is [0.0,0.0,0.0].

title: dTopInnerRadius​
content: A Double specifying the inner radius in meters of the top end of the cylinder.The default value is 0.001.

title: dTopOuterRadius​
content: A Double specifying the outer radius in meters of the top end of the cylinder.The default value is 0.01.

title: dBottomInnerRadius​
content: A Double specifying the inner radius in meters of the bottom end of the cylinder.The default value is 0.001.

title: dBottomOuterRadius​
content: A Double specifying the outer radius in meters of the bottom end of the cylinder.The default value is 0.01.

title: dHeight​
content: A Double specifying the height of the cylinder.The default value is 0.01.

title: iCircularNodes​
content: An Integer specifying the number of nodes to be generated on the circle at both ends.The default value is 36.

title: iAxialNodes​
content: An Integer specifying the number of nodes in the axial direction of the cylinder.The default value is 10.

title: iPartColor​
content: An Integer specifying the color of the newly created part.The default value is 7105764.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created part.

title: Sample Code​
content: created_cylinder = Geometry.Part.Cylinder(dlOrigin=[0.005, 0.005, 0.005], strName="Cylinder_2", iPartColor=7463537) JPT.Debugger(created_cylinder)

title: Description​
content: Create a donut body in a specific location. Its relative location is computed to the specified local coordinate system.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Part.Torus(...)  Macro: CreateTorus Ribbon: Geometry » Part » Torus

title: dlOrigin​
content: A List of Double specifying the X, Y, and Z coordinates of the origin point (The center of the torus).The default value is [0.0,0.0,0.0].

title: dInnerRadius​
content: A Double specifying the radius of the inner circle of the torus in meter.The default value is 0.015.

title: dRingRadius​
content: A Double specifying the radius of the ring of the torus in meter.The default value is 0.02.

title: iCircumNodes​
content: An Integer specifying the number of nodes to be generated on the circumference of the ring of the torus.The default value is 20.

title: iRingNodes​
content: An Integer specifying the number of nodes to be generated on the cross-section of the ring of the torus.The default value is 20.

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the creating part.The default value is "Torus_1".

title: iPartColor​
content: An Integer specifying the color of the creating part.The default value is 7105764.

title: crLocalCoordinate​
content: A Cursor specifying the local coordinate system.The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: The return value depends on the status of the creating process: Cursor: The torus is created successfully.None: The torus cannot be created.

title: Sample Code​
content: torus = Geometry.Part.Torus(dlOrigin=[0.005, 0.005, 0.005], strName="Torus", iPartColor=7697908) JPT.Debugger(torus)

title: Description​
content: This method removes Boss or Rib geometry and replaces it with a smooth face.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.RemoveRibBoss(crlFaces, dGradiation=1.0, iContinuity=1)  Ribbon: Geometry » Remove Rib/Boss

title: crlFaces​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the adjacent faces around the Rib or Boss geometry. These faces must be connected to each other.This is a required input.

title: dGradiation​
content: A Double specifying the gradation value. It defines the rate at which the mesh transitions between high mesh density and low mesh density for the new smooth face. Possible values are greater than or equal to 0.5.The default value is 1.0.

title: iContinuity​
content: An Integer specifying the connection continuity factor. It defines the rate at which the smooth shape transition between the bound face and the new smooth face. The possible values that iContinuity can take are 0, 1, and 2.The default value is 1.

title: Return Code​
content: A String of 1 if success, or 0 if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube(ilAxialNodes=[11, 11, 11]) Geometry.Edge.Line(dllPoints=[[0.01, 0.01, 0.005], [0, 0.01, 0.005]], crlFaces=[Face(22)]) Geometry.Part.Cylinder(dlOrigin=[0.005, 0.01, 0.005], dTopRadius=0.002, dBottomRadius=0.002, dHeight=0.003) Assemble.BooleanEx([Part(1, 2)]) Geometry.RemoveRibBoss(crlFaces=[Face(35, 37)])

title: Description​
content: Create a tubular body around specific edge(s).

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Part.Tube(...)  Ribbon: Geometry » Part » Tube

title: crlEdges​
content: A List of Cursor specifying edges which will be the center axis of the created tube.This is a required input.

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the newly created part.The default value is "Tube_1".

title: bTri​
content: A Boolean specifying the mesh type of newly created part. If True, Tri3 element will be used.If False, Quad4 element will be used. The default value is True.

title: dRadius​
content: A Double specifying the radius of the tube.The default value is 0.01.

title: dMeshSizeAxis​
content: A Double specifying the mesh size of the center axis.The default value is 0.005.

title: dWMeshSizeCirc​

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created part.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() created_tube = Geometry.Part.Tube(strName="Tube_1", crlEdges=[Edge(19)]) JPT.Debugger(created_tube)

title: Description​

title: Description​
content: This method stitches any gap between free edges that are slightly apart.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.StitchEdge(crlMaster, crlSlave, dTolerance=0.3, bKeepSlave=True)  Macro: StitchEdge Ribbon: Geometry » Stitch Edge

title: crlMaster​
content: A List of Cursor specifying master edges will be retained after operation.This is a required input.

title: crlSlave​
content: A List of Cursor specifying slave edges to be stitched.This is a required input.

title: dTolerance​
content: A Double specifying the stitch tolerance. The free edges are at a distance less than or equal to the specified value will be stitched.The default value is 0.3.

title: bKeepSlave​

title: Return Code​

title: Description​
content: Translate two parts such that the specified two cylindrical surfaces concentric.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Transform.CylinderFace(...)  Ribbon: Geometry » Transform » Cylinder Face

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the cylinder part.This is a required input.

title: veclPoint​
content: A List of Vector specifying the points to define the matching plane from source and target. It contains the position of six points, the first three points define the source face, the others define the target face.The default value is [[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]].

title: bCreateNewPart​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to keep the original part and create a new part after the transform operation.The default value is False.

title: bCopyLBC​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy load boundary condition from original part to transformed one. This argument will be ignored if bCreateNewPart=False.The default value is False.

title: bCopyProperty​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy property from original part to transformed one. This argument will be ignored if bCreateNewPart=False.The default value is False.

title: Return Code​
content: No return value.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cylinder() Geometry.Part.Cylinder(dlOrigin=[0.02, 0.0, 0.0], strName="Cylinder_2", iPartColor=6812659) Geometry.Transform.CylinderFace(crlParts=[Part(1), Part(2)], veclPoint=[[0, 0, 0], [0, -1000, 0], [10, 0, 0], [0, 10, 0], [0, -990, 0], [10.0, 10, 10]], bCreateNewPart=True)

title: Description​
content: This method mirrors existing part geometry across a plane to create new geometry.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Transform.Mirror(crlParts, veclPoint=[[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]], dOffset=0.0, bCreateNewPart=True, bCopyLBC=False, bCopyProperty=False, bRemoveDupFace=True, bMergeNode=False, dTol=1e-05)  Macro: MirrorBody Ribbon: Geometry » Transform » Mirror

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the parts to mirror.This is a required input.

title: veclPoint​
content: A List of Vector specifying the X-, Y-, and Z-coordinates of three-points to define the mirror plane.The default value is [[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]].

title: dOffset​
content: A Double specifying the offset amount from the mirror plane.The default value is 0.0.

title: bCreateNewPart​
content: A Boolean specifying whether or not the mirrored part should be moved to a new part and keep the original part as is.The default value is True.

title: bCopyLBC​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy all load boundary condition from original part to mirrored part. This argument will be ignored if bCreateNewPart=False.The default value is False.

title: bCopyProperty​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy all property from original part to mirrored part. This argument will be ignored if bCreateNewPart=False.The default value is False.

title: bRemoveDupFace​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the faces which overlap the mirrored with the original part. This argument will be ignored if bCreateNewPart=False.The default value is True.

title: bMergeNode​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to merge nodes of mirrored part and the original part are at a distance of less than or equal to the specified value.The default value is False.

title: dTol​
content: A Double specifying the maximum distance of the coupling nodes. This argument will be ignored if bMergeNode=False.The default value is 1e-05.

title: Return Code​
content: A String of 1 if success, or 0 if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Wedge() Geometry.Transform.Mirror(crlParts=[Part(1)], veclPoint=[[0.012, 0, 0], [0, 0.012, 0], [0.012, 0, 1]])

title: Description​
content: Translate parts by defining mating faces, mating edges, and mating points.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Transform.MatingFace(...)  Ribbon: Geometry » Transform » Mating Face

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying parts to transform.This is a required input.

title: crSrcFace​
content: A Cursor specifying the face to be used as the source for the transform operation.This is a required input.

title: crDstFace​
content: A Cursor specifying the face to be used as the reference for the transform operation.This is a required input.

title: crSrcEdge​
content: A Cursor specifying the edge to be used as the source for the transform operation.The default value is None.

title: crDstEdge​
content: A Cursor specifying the edge to be used as the reference for the transform operation. This argument must be specified when iAlignMethodType=0.The default value is None.

title: crSrcNode​
content: A Cursor specifying the node to be used as the source for the transform operation.The default value is None.

title: crDstNode​
content: A Cursor specifying the node to be used as the reference for the transform operation. This argument must be specified when iAdjustPointType=0.The default value is None.

title: iFaceOpposite​
content: An Integer specifying whether or not the source surface should be on the opposite side of the destination surface. If iFaceOpposite=0: The source surface lay on the current side of the destination surface.If iFaceOpposite=1: The source surface lay on the opposite side of the destination surface. The default value is 0.

title: dEdgeAngle​
content: A Double specifying the angle in degrees between two specified edges, crSrcEdge and crDstEdge, after the transform operation.The default value is 0.0.

title: iEdgeOpposite​
content: An Integer specifying whether to match the opposite direction of source edge to destination edge. If iEdgeOpposite=0: Match the current direction of source edge to destination edge.If iEdgeOpposite=1: Match the opposite direction of source edge to destination edge. The default value is 0.

title: iAlignMethodType​
content: An Integer specifying how to align the edges between the source and the destination. This argument will be ignored if crSrcEdge has a default value. If iAlignMethodType=0: Move the given source part so that crSrcEdge is coincident with crDstEdge.If iAlignMethodType=1: Move crSrcEdge edges along the direction of the specified vector dlAlignVector. The default value is 0.

title: iAdjustPointType​
content: An Integer specifying how to move the node along the direction. This argument will be ignored if crSrcNode has a default value. If iAdjustPointType=0: Move on a direction defined by two nodes, from source and destination.If iAdjustPointType=1: Move on a direction defined by a node and a coordinate, from source and destination. The default value is 0.

title: iAdjustProjectionType​
content: An Integer specifying the projection direction. This argument will be ignored if crSrcNode has a default value. If iAdjustProjectionType=0: Projection direction is the normal direction of the surface.If iAdjustProjectionType=1: Projection direction is the specified vector dlAdjustVector. The default value is 0.

title: dlAlignVector​
content: A List of Double specifying the alignment vector. This argument is used when iAlignMethodType=1.The default value is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0].

title: dlAdjustPoint​
content: A List of Double specifying the destination point which crSrcNode will move to. This argument is used when iAdjustPointType=1.The default value is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0].

title: dlAdjustVector​
content: A List of Double specifying adjustment vector. This argument is used when iAdjustPointType=1.The default value is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0].

title: bCreateNewPart​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to keep the original part and make a copy one then transform.The default value is False.

title: bCopyLBC​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy load boundary condition of original part to transformed part. This argument is used when bCreateNewPart=True.The default value is False.

title: bCopyProperty​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy property of original part to transformed part. This argument is used when bCreateNewPart=True.The default value is False.

title: bIsPreview​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to enable preview or not.The default value is False.

title: crlCoordSyss​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the coordinate systems.The default value is [].

title: Return Code​
content: No return value.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() Geometry.Part.Cylinder(dlOrigin=[0.02, 0.005, 0.005], dTopOuterRadius=0.005, dBottomOuterRadius=0.005) Geometry.Transform.MatingFace(crlParts=[Part(2)], crSrcFace=Face(30), crDstFace=Face(22))

title: Description​
content: This method moves the parts by selecting three pairs of nodes. The given parts move onto a target position in a one-one correspondence between source and target.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Transform.Position(crlParts, veclPoint=[[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]], bCreateNewPart=False, bCopyLBC=False, bCopyProperty=False)  Macro: PositionBody Ribbon: Geometry » Transform » Position

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the parts to be transformed.This is a required input.

title: veclPoint​
content: A List of Vector specifying the points using for movement. Six points are required corresponding to three pairs of nodes respectively. Each pair is in a one-one correspondence between target and source.The default value is [[0.0,0.0,0.0]].

title: bCreateNewPart​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy the transformed parts to new parts.The default value is False.

title: bCopyLBC​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy load boundary conditions from the existing part to new parts. This argument will only affect the functionality when bCreateNewPart=True.The default value is False.

title: bCopyProperty​
content: A Boolean selecting whether to copy property from the existing part to new parts. This argument will only affect the functionality when bCreateNewPart=True.The default value is False.

title: Return Code​
content: A String of 1 if success, or 0 if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=14540142) Geometry.Part.Wedge(vecOrigin=[0.01, 0.01, 0.01], iPartColor=6678885) Geometry.Transform.Position(crlParts=[Part(1)], veclPoint=[[0.0, 0.0, 10.0], [10.0, 0.0, 10.0], [0.0, 10.0, 10.0], [10.0, 10.0, 20.0], [20.0, 10.0, 20.0], [10.0, 20.0, 20.0]])

title: Description​
content: Rotate given parts by the specified angle.

title: Syntax​
content: Geometry.Transform.Rotation(...)  Macro: RotateBody Ribbon: Geometry » Transform » Rotation

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the parts to be rotated.The default value is [].

title: posCenter​
content: A List specifying the center position of rotation.The default value is [0,0,0].

title: vecAxis​
content: A List specifying the axis of rotation.The default value is [1,0,0].

title: dAngle​
content: A Double specifying the rotation angle.The default value is 0.

title: bCreateNewPart​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy a new one and perform the transform operation.The default value is False.

title: bCopyLBC​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy load boundary condition of the original part to rotation part. This argument will be ignored if bCreateNewPart=False.The default value is False.

title: bCopyProperty​
content: A Boolean specifying the option that copy property of the original part to rotation part. This argument will be ignored if bCreateNewPart=False.The default value is False.

title: iCopyCount​
content: An Integer specifying the number of copy parts. This argument will be ignored if bCreateNewPart=False.The default value is 1.

title: bMergeNode​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to merge nodes between the original part and the transformed one. This argument will be ignored if bCreateNewPart=False.The default value is False.

title: dTol​

title: Description​
content: Move the parts by selecting three pairs of nodes. The selected parts are moved onto the target position in a one-to-one correspondence between source and target.

content: Geometry.Transform.ThreePoints(...)  Ribbon: Geometry » Transform » ThreePoints

title: crlTargetParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the parts to be transformed.This is a required input.

title: poslOriginalPoints​
content: A List of Vector specifying the original points using for movement. Three points are required corresponding to three original points.This is a required input.

title: poslNextPoints​
content: A List of Vector specifying the next points using for movement. Three points are required corresponding to three next points, respectively to the three original pointed defined in poslOriginalPoints.This is a required input.

content: A Boolean specifying whether to copy the transformed parts to new parts. If True, a new part is copied to new location.If False, the original part is moved to new location. The default value is False.

title: bCopyReference​

title: Description​
content: Project nodes of the meshed faces to the selected CAD (Reference) part.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.CADProjection.Face(...)  Ribbon: Meshing » CAD Projection » Face

title: crCadPart​
content: A Cursor specifying the CAD parts. Faces on selected parts will be the referenced faces for projection. Note that for CAD part, Cursor type will take different format from normal cursor's format. Two parameters are now needed: the former is ID (external id) and the latter is Key (internal id).For example: RefPart((1,2)) means a CAD part with ID (external id) = 1 and Key (internal id) = 2. This is a required input.

title: crlMeshedFaces​
content: A List of Cursor specifying list of meshed faces. Nodes on these faces will be projected onto referenced faces.This is a required input.

title: bForceProject​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to force projection or not. If True, Jupiter will try to do projection more aggressively, hence may takes more time to finish.The default value is False.

title: bProjectCornerNodes​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to project corner nodes or not. If True, corner nodes of elements will be projected.The default value is True.

title: bProjectMidNodes​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to project mid nodes or not. If True, mid nodes of elements will be projected.The default value is False.

title: bIDcheck​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to check ID when projecting or not. If True, nodes (on selected meshed faces) will only be projected to CAD faces (in the selected CAD Parts) whose ID is the same as the meshed face of those nodes. For example, if one node is on face 5, that node will only be projected to CAD face (in selected CAD Parts) with the same ID (i.e. 5).If False, ID check will be skipped, and projection takes place when nodes and CAD faces (in the selected CAD parts) are at the closest distance. The default value is False.

title: Return Code​
content: A Boolean specifying the status of the process: True: Projected the nodes of the meshed faces to the CAD (Reference) part.False: Cannot project the nodes of the meshed faces to the CAD (Reference) part.

title: Description​
content: Project nodes to the selected CAD (Reference) faces.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.CADProjection.NodeToFace(...)  Ribbon: Meshing » CADProjection » NodeToFace

title: crlCadFaces​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the CAD Faces. These Faces will be the reference faces for projection. Note that for CAD face, Cursor type will take different format from normal cursor's format. Two parameters are now needed: the former is ID (external id) and the latter is Key (internal id).For example: RefFace((1,2)) means a CAD face with ID (external id) = 1 and Key (internal id) = 2. This is a required input.

title: crlMeshedNodes​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the Meshed Nodes. These Nodes will be projected onto the reference faces.This is a required input.

title: iDirection​
content: An Integer specifying the direction for projection. Cannot be used together with iImproveQuality.The default value is 0.

title: iImproveQuality​
content: An Integer specifying whether improve quality is needed or not. Improve quality means to adjust the elements after creation, to optimize the quality.The default value is 0. 注記 Selected projection direction (iDirection) is ignored in this case.

title: Return Code​
content: A Boolean specifying the status of the process: True: Projected nodes to the CAD (Reference) faces.False: Cannot project nodes to the CAD (Reference) faces.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cylinder(iPartColor=15658599) Meshing.SetMeshAttribute(crlParts=[Part(1)], surfaceMesh=SURFACE_MESH(dGeomAngle=0.7853981634, iPerformanceMode=1, dAutoMergeTinyFacesAngle=0.5235987756, bGeomApprox=True, iNextEntityOffsetId=0)) Meshing.SurfaceMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1)], surfaceMesh=SURFACE_MESH(dGeomAngle=0.7853981634, iPerformanceMode=1, dAutoMergeTinyFacesAngle=0.5235987756, bGeomApprox=True, iNextEntityOffsetId=0)) Meshing.SolidMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1)], bTet10=True, dGradingFactor=1.05, dStretchLimit=0.1, iSpeedVsQual=1, iRegion=1, bSafeMode=False, iParallel=8, bInternalMeshOnly=False, iPartColor=65280) Meshing.CADProjection.NodeToFace(crlCadFaces=[RefFace((5,5))], crlMeshedNodes=[Node(691)])

title: Description​
content: Create a mesh with grid pattern for the selected faces.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.GridMesh(...)  Ribbon: Meshing » GridMesh

title: listGridMesh​
content: A List specifying the parameters of Grid Mesh function (Refer to GRID_MESH). Each parameter specifying an option of Grid Mesh funciton.This is a required input.

title: bProjectToCad​
content: A Boolean used to enable/disable CAD projection. If this is enabled (True), after meshing, the meshed nodes is projected back to CAD model.The default value is False.

title: strGroupName​
content: A String specifying the name of a DGroup to contain the chosen target faces. If this parameter is left blank (""), no group will be created.The default value is "".

title: bMakeNewGroup​
content: A Boolean specifying whether the function creates a new group or not: True: Add all the meshed faces to a new group which will be created after executing the function.False: Add all the meshed faces to the nearly created group after executing the function. The default value is False.

title: Return Code​
content: A Boolean of True if success, or False if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube(strName="Cube_2", iPartColor=5820248) Geometry.MakeFillet(crlEdges=[Edge(18, 19, 15)]) meshed_status = Meshing.GridMesh(listGridMesh=[GRID_MESH(crlFaces=[Face(29)], crlCorner=[Node(1838, 1837, 1387, 1397)], ilMeshCount=[3, 3], iShape=4), GRID_MESH(crlFaces=[Face(27)], crlCorner=[Node(1837, 1836, 489, 499)], ilMeshCount=[3, 3], iShape=4), GRID_MESH(crlFaces=[Face(28)], crlCorner=[Node(1386, 1376, 1836, 1838)], ilMeshCount=[3, 3], iShape=4), GRID_MESH(crlFaces=[Face(30)], crlCorner=[Node(1837, 1838, 1836)], ilMeshCount=[3], iShape=3)], bProjectToCad=True, strGroupName="GridMeshFace") JPT.Debugger(meshed_status)

title: Description​
content: Project nodes of the meshed faces to the selected CAD (Reference) faces.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.CADProjection.FaceToFace(...)  Ribbon: Meshing » CADProjection » FaceToFace

title: crlCadFaces​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the CAD Faces. These Faces will be the reference faces for projection. Note that for CAD face, Cursor type will take different format from normal cursor's format. Two parameters are now needed: the former is ID (external id) and the latter is Key (internal id).For example: RefFace((1,2)) means a CAD face with ID (external id) = 1 and Key (internal id) = 2. This is a required input.

title: crlMeshedFaces​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the Meshed Faces. This face will be projected onto reference faces.This is a required input.

title: <!--bForceProject​
content: A Boolean to enable/disable forcing projection. If True, Jupiter will try to do projection more aggressively, hence may takes more time to finish.The default value is False.

title: bProjectCornerNodes​
content: A Boolean to enable/disable corner nodes projection. If True, corner nodes of elements will be projected.The default value is False.

title: bProjectMidNodes​
content: A Boolean to enable/disable mid nodes projection. If True, mid nodes of elements will be projected.The default value is True.

title: bIDcheck​
content: A Boolean to enable/disable ID check when projecting.The default value is True.

title: Return Code​
content: A Boolean specifying the status of the process: True: Projected the nodes of the meshed faces to the CAD (Reference) faces.False: Cannot project the nodes of the meshed faces to the CAD (Reference) faces.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cylinder() Geometry.Part.Cylinder(dlOrigin=[0.0, 0.0, 0.02], strName="Cylinder_2", iPartColor=6409934) Geometry.FCircVertexAdjust(crlParts=[Part(1, 2)]) Meshing.SetMeshAttribute(crlParts=[Part(1, 2)], surfaceMesh=SURFACE_MESH(dMaxElemSize=0.015, dMinElemSize=0.0005, dGeomAngle=0.7853981634, dMinStretchVal=0.0, iPerformanceMode=1, dAutoMergeTinyFacesAngle=0.5235987756, bGeomApprox=True, iNextEntityOffsetId=0)) Meshing.SurfaceMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1, 2)], surfaceMesh=SURFACE_MESH(dMaxElemSize=0.015, dMinElemSize=0.0005, dGeomAngle=0.7853981634, dMinStretchVal=0.0, iPerformanceMode=1, dAutoMergeTinyFacesAngle=0.5235987756, bGeomApprox=True, iNextEntityOffsetId=0), iThreadNum=4) Meshing.SolidMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1, 2)], bTet10=True, dGradingFactor=1.05, dStretchLimit=0.1, iSpeedVsQual=1, iRegion=1, bSafeMode=False, iParallel=4, bInternalMeshOnly=False, iPartColor=65280) Meshing.CADProjection.FaceToFace(crlCadFaces=[RefFace((5, 5))], crlMeshedFaces=[Face(10)], bProjectCornerNodes=True, bIDcheck=False)

title: Description​
content: Mesh the selected solid elements locally without affecting the other positions.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.LocalRemesh.Solid(...)  Ribbon: Meshing » LocalRemesh » Solid

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the parts list to perform remesh.This is a required input.

title: dlCenter​
content: A List of Double specifying the center of the sphere. This sphere is the region to remesh.The default value is [0.0,0.0,0.0].

title: dRadius​
content: A Double specifying the radius of the remesh sphere in millimeter.The default value is 5.0.

title: dGradFactor​
content: A Double specifying the grading factor of the result mesh.The default value is 1.0.

title: dStretchLimit​
content: A Double specifying the stretch limit of the elements in the result mesh.The default value is 0.1.

title: Return Code​
content: A Boolean specifying whether the process is executed successfully or not: True: The process is executed successfully.False: Cannot execute the function.

title: Sample Code​
content: cube = Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=12603072) MeshEdit.MoveNode.CADFollows(crlNodes=[Node(453)], dMovedPosX=5.527019999999999, dMovedPosY=5.43058, dMovedPosZ=10.0) Meshing.SolidMeshing(crlParts=[cube], bTet10=True, dGradingFactor=1.05, dStretchLimit=0.1, iSpeedVsQual=1, iRegion=1, bSafeMode=False, iParallel=4, bSurfaceNodes=False, bEdgeNodes=False, bPreservation=False, iPartColor=65280) remesh_status = Meshing.LocalRemesh.Solid(crlParts=[cube], dlCenter=[0.005555555555555556, 0.005555555555555556, 0.01], dRadius=2.0) JPT.Debugger(remesh_status)

title: Description​
content: Search Target Faces for Local mesh setting

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.LocalSetting.SearchTargetFaces(iPartType=0, dlOrigin=[0, 0, 0], dlLength=[0.1, 0.1, 0.1], dlCenterPt=[0.0,0.0,0.0], dlAxisPt1=[0.0,0.0,0.1], dlAxisPt2=[0.0,0.0,0.0], bEnclosed=False)  Macro: SearchTargetFacesInModel Ribbon: Meshing » LocalSetting » SearchTargetFaces

title: iPartType​
content: An Integer specifying the part type.The default value is 0.

title: dlOrigin​
content: A Double List specifying the original.The default value is [0, 0, 0].

title: dlLength​
content: A Double List specifying the length.The default value is [0.1, 0.1, 0.1].

title: dlCenterPt​
content: A Double List specifying the center point.The default value is [0.0,0.0,0.0].

title: dlAxisPt1​
content: A Double List specifying the axis point 1.The default value is [0.0,0.0,0.1].

title: dlAxisPt2​
content: A Double List specifying the axis point 2.The default value is [0.0,0.0,0.0].

title: bEnclosed​
content: A Boolean specifying the enclosed.The default value is False.

title: Return Code​
content: A String of 1 if success, or 0 if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: Meshing.LocalSetting.SearchTargetFaces(iPartType=0, dlOrigin=[0, 0, 0], dlLength=[0.1, 0.1, 0.1], dlCenterPt=[0.0,0.0,0.0], dlAxisPt1=[0.0,0.0,0.1], dlAxisPt2=[0.0,0.0,0.0], bEnclosed=False)

title: Description​
content: Select and mesh all the existing fillet faces.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.LocalMeshing.FilletMapping(...)  Ribbon: Meshing » LocalMeshing » FilletMapping

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of target parts to search for fillet faces.The default value is [].

title: crlFaces​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the list of target faces to search for fillet faces.The default value is [].

title: dMinArcLength​
content: A Double specifying the minimum length of fillet edge in meter. This is a search criterion.The default value is 0.0.

title: dMaxArcLength​
content: A Double specifying the maximum length of fillet edge in meter. This is a search criterion.The default value is 0.009.

title: dMinArcRadius​
content: A Double specifying the minimum radius of fillet edge in meter. This is a search criterion.The default value is 0.0.

title: dMaxArcRadius​
content: A Double specifying the maximum radius of fillet edge in meter. This is a search criterion.The default value is 1.0.

title: bConvex​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the search for convex fillet.The default value is True.

title: bConcave​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the search for concave fillet.The default value is True.

title: dLayerAngle​
content: A Double specifying the angle between each fillet layer in degrees.The default value is 30.

title: dAxisAspectRatio​
content: A Double specifying the ratio of the length to the width of a layer.The default value is 3.

title: dAxisMinSize​
content: A Double specifying the minimum size for each dimension of a layer cell, in meter.The default value is 0.001

title: bAxisMinSize​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use min size criterion or not.The default value is True.

title: dAxisMaxSize​
content: A Double specifying the maximum size for each dimension of a layer cell, in meter.The default value is 0.003.

title: bAxisMaxSize​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use max size criterion or not.The default value is True.

title: iAxisMinMeshCount​
content: An Integer specifying the minimum node count on each dimension of every fillet faces. If a fillet faces has a dimension whose node count is less than the criterion, map meshing on the face will be skipped.The default value is 1.

title: bAxisMinMeshCount​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use min mesh count criterion or not.The default value is True.

title: iElementType​
content: An Integer specifying the type 2D element to be created. It can be one of the following: 0: Tri3.1: Quad4. The default value is 0.

title: dSingleLayerLength​
content: A Double specifying the maximum length of the single layer in meter.The default value is 0.001.

title: bSingleLayerLength​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use single layer length criterion or not.The default value is True.

title: dSingleLayerRadius​
content: A Double specifying the maximum radius of the single layer in meter.The default value is 0.001.

title: bSingleLayerRadius​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use single layer radius criterion or not.The default value is False.

title: iMinNumLayer​
content: An Integer specifying the minimum number of layers to be created.The default value is 3.

title: bMinNumLayer​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use single min number of layers criterion or not.The default value is True.

title: bCreateReference=False​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to create a reference part after meshing or not.The default value is True.

title: bRemeshTheEnd​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to use local remesh for ending position of fillet to fit with surrounding mesh size or not.The default value is False.

title: bSkipComplexFace​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to skip complex fillet faces or not.The default value is False.

title: Return Code​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the meshed fillet faces, or None if failed.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() Geometry.MakeFillet(crlEdges=[Edge(18, 19, 15)]) fillet_faces = Meshing.LocalMeshing.SelectFillet(crlParts=[Part(1)], crlFaces=[]) fillet_meshing = \ Meshing.LocalMeshing.FilletMapping(crlFaces=[Face(*[int(str(_).split(":")[-1].strip()) for _ in fillet_faces])]) JPT.Debugger(fillet_meshing)

title: dMaxArcLength​

title: dMinArcRadius​

title: bConvex​

title: Description​
content: Set the mesh setting for the selected faces (Define the settings before surface mesh creation).

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.LocalSettings.Face(...)  Ribbon: Meshing » LocalSettings » Face

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the local mesh setting.This is a required input.

title: localMesh​
content: A LOCAL_MESH specifying the local mesh setting's parameter.This is a required input.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the target Faces of the local mesh setting.This is a required input.

title: crEditTarget​
content: A Cursor specifying an existed local mesh setting Face. When this parameter is used, the specified local mesh setting Face will be overwritten. When it is not used, a new local mesh setting Face will be created.The default value is None.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() local_mesh = Meshing.LocalSettings.Face(strName="MeshParam_1", localMesh=LOCAL_MESH(iEntityType=3, dAvgElemSize=0.005, dMaxElemSize=0.01, dMinElemSize=0.001, dTrimAngle=0.7853981634, bEnableMeshCount=True, iNodeCount=8), crlTargets=[Edge(18)]) JPT.Debugger(local_mesh) Geometry.FCircVertexAdjust(crlParts=[Part(1)]) Meshing.SetMeshAttribute(crlParts=[Part(1)], surfaceMesh=SURFACE_MESH(dMaxElemSize=0.015, dMinElemSize=0.0005, dGeomAngle=0.7853981634, dGeomMinSize=0.0005, dMinStretchVal=0.0, iPerformanceMode=1, dAutoMergeTinyFacesAngle=0.5235987756, bGeomApprox=True, iNextEntityOffsetId=0)) Meshing.SurfaceMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1)], surfaceMesh=SURFACE_MESH(dMaxElemSize=0.015, dMinElemSize=0.0005, dGeomAngle=0.7853981634, dGeomMinSize=0.0005, dMinStretchVal=0.0, iPerformanceMode=1, dAutoMergeTinyFacesAngle=0.5235987756, bGeomApprox=True, iNextEntityOffsetId=0), iThreadNum=4)

title: Description​
content: Remesh the selected faces.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.LocalRemesh.Surface(...)  Macro: LocalRemeshTriQuad Ribbon: Meshing » LocalRemesh » Surface

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the target for surface remeshing. This target can be Parts, Faces, Edges, or Elements.This is a required input.

title: surfaceMesh​
content: A SURFACE_MESH specifying the mesh parameter.This is a required input.

title: bUseSetting​
content: A Boolean to enable or disable the use of local setting. If this parameter is disabled (False), the existing local mesh settings will not be used.The default value is True.

title: bGrading​
content: A Boolean to enable or disable the gradation of mesh. If enabled (True), surrounding faces will be remeshed together with the selected targets. If disabled (False), only selected targets will be remeshed.The default value is False.

title: bFMesher​
content: A Boolean to enable or disable the use of F-mesher. F-mesher is a mesher to create only Quad4 elements. If surfaceMesh is set to create Tri3 element, this option does not have any effect.The default value is False.

title: iOverrideType​
content: An Integer specifying the mesh pattern type. 0 (IsoMesh): Create isotropic mesh (structured mesh) on selected targets, if applicable.1 (FreeMesh): Create free mesh (unstructured mesh) on selected targets. The default value is 1.

title: bKeepConnection​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the keeping of connection (boundary conditions) after meshing.The default value is False.

title: bProjCAD​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the projection of remeshed targets onto CAD models.The default value is True.

title: bIDcheck​
content: A Boolean to enable or disable ID check when projecting.

title: bTinyFaceMerge​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the merge of tiny faces before remeshing. This option is equivalent to Geometry.MergeEntities.TinyFacesMerge.The default value is False.

title: dMinFaceWidth​
content: A Double specifying the minimum face width. If bTinyFaceMerge is True, this parameter will be used to search for tiny faces.The default value is 0.

title: dMaxFaceWidth​
content: A Double specifying the maximum face width. If bTinyFaceMerge is True, this parameter will be used to search for tiny faces.The default value is 0.001.

title: bKeepRemeshEdge​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) thee keeping of edges created when remeshing. This option only works when selected targets are Elements 2D. If disabled, the selected elements will be separated into new faces, new edges will also be created. If enabled, new faces and edges will not be created.The default value is False.

title: Return Code​
content: A Boolean of True if success, or False if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() creating_status = Meshing.LocalRemesh.Surface(crlTargets=[Face(26)], surfaceMesh=SURFACE_MESH(dAvgElemSize=0.0005, dMaxElemSize=0.001, dMinElemSize=0.0001, dGeomAngle=0.7853981853, iPerformanceMode=1, dAutoMergeTinyFacesAngle=0.5235987902, bLocalRemesh=True, iNextEntityOffsetId=8985, iNextElemOffsetId=2601), bGrading=True, iOverrideType=0) JPT.Debugger(creating_status)

title: Description​
content: Specify setting for fixed node position (Hard Point) when you create surface mesh, to ensure node creation at a specified location.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.LocalSettings.Points(...)  Ribbon: Meshing » LocalSettings » Points

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the local mesh setting.This is a required input.

title: localMesh​
content: A LOCAL_MESHspecifying the local mesh setting's parameter.This is a required input.

title: veclHardPointXYZ​

title: Description​
content: Do 3D meshing (Tetrahedral) for the selected parts. 注記 In case the total number of selected parts = 0, all the existing parts will be used as an input.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.SolidMeshing(...)  Macro: VolMeshing Ribbon: Meshing » SolidMeshing

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the target Parts.This is a required input.

title: bTet10​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the Tet10 creation. If enabled, solid elements Tet4 will be converted to Tet10.The default value is False.

title: dGradingFactor​
content: A Double specifying the grading factor. This parameter affects the change of mesh size from small mesh area to large mesh area.The default value is 0.

title: dStretchLimit​
content: A Double specifying the stretch limit of the result mesh. Created mesh will be adjusted in order to reduce the amount of elements whose stretch is greater than this parameter.The default value is 0.

title: iSpeedVsQual​
content: An Integer specifying the priority between mesh quality and mesh generation speed. If 0: Speed is prioritized (Fastest).If 1: Mesh quality is prioritized (Optimized). The default value is 0.

title: iSpeedVsMem​
content: An Integer specifying the priority between memory usage and mesh generation speed. If 0: Speed is prioritized (Standard).If 1: The reduction of memory usage is prioritized (Low Memory). The default value is 0.

title: iRegion​
content: An Integer specifying the region where mesh will be generated. If 0: Create the solid elements in only the main area of part (Main region).If 1: Create solid element to all the area of the part (All Region). The default value is 0.

title: bInternalNodes​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the creation of extra nodes. If disabled, nodes on surfaces will be modified. If enabled, only nodes will only be created inside target parts.The default value is True.

title: bSafeMode​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) safe mode. This mode is used to enhance very small element's quality.The default value is True.

title: iParallel​
content: An Integer specifying the number of CPU threads for parallel meshing. This parameter must be smaller than the maximum number of CPU cores.The default value is 0.

title: bSurfaceNodes​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the cleaning of surface nodes. This parameter is for clean-up step. If enabled, surface nodes will be slightly moved to improve mesh quality.The default value is True.

title: bEdgeNodes​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the cleaning of edge nodes. This parameter is for clean-up step. If enabled, edge nodes will be slightly moved to improve mesh quality.The default value is True.

title: bPreservation​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the preservation of nodes. This parameter is for clean-up step. If disabled, nodes can be moved to improve mesh quality.The default value is True.

title: bInternalMeshOnly​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the correction of internal mesh only. This parameter is for clean-up step.The default value is True.

title: bMeshColor​
content: A Boolean to enable (True) or disable (False) the use of mesh color. If enabled, target parts' color will be changed according to iPartColor.The default value is False.

title: iPartColor​
content: An Integer specifying the color of the result mesh parts.The default value is 2763429.

title: Return Code​
content: A Boolean of True if success, or False if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() meshing_status = Meshing.SolidMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1)], bTet10=True, dGradingFactor=1.05, dStretchLimit=0.1, iSpeedVsQual=1, iRegion=1, bSafeMode=False, iParallel=24, bSurfaceNodes=False, bEdgeNodes=False, bInternalMeshOnly=False, iPartColor=65280) JPT.Debugger(meshing_status)

title: Description​
content: Do 2D meshing for the selected parts. The Meshing.SetMeshAttribute function will be used as input parameters. 注記 This function support triangular and quadrilateral element.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.SurfaceMeshing(...)  Macro: SurfaceMeshing2D Ribbon: Meshing » Surface Meshing

title: crlParts​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the parts needed to create mesh.This is a required input.

title: surfaceMesh​
content: A SURFACE_MESH specifying the mesh parameter.This is a required input.

title: bUseSetting​
content: A Boolean to enable or disable the use of local setting. If this parameter is disabled (False), the existing local mesh setting will not be used.The default value is True.

title: bFMesher​
content: A Boolean specifying the status of F-mesher (Disabled/Enabled). F-mesher is a mesher to create only Quad4 elements. If surfaceMesh is set to create Tri3 element, this options does not have any effect.The default value is False.

title: iThreadNum​
content: An Integer specifying the number of CPU threads for parallel meshing. This mesher create parallel meshing for each independent (no assembled face) part on each thread. If 2 parts are assembled together, they will be treated as a single part for parallel meshing. This parameter must be smaller than the maximum number of CPU cores.The default value is 8.

title: bRefData​
content: A Boolean specifying the status of the creating of Reference data (Disabled/Enabled). Reference data is used to store CAD model. If this parameter is enabled (True), Reference data will be kept after meshing.The default value is True.

title: bMeshColor​
content: A Boolean to enable or disable the use of mesh color. If this parameter is enabled (True), the result meshed parts will be colored as described by iPartColor.The default value is False.

title: iPartColor​
content: An Integer specifying the color of result meshed parts.The default value is 65280 (White).

title: Return Code​
content: A Boolean of True if success, or False if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() Meshing.SetMeshAttribute(crlParts=[Part(1)], surfaceMesh=SURFACE_MESH(dGeomAngle=0.7853981634, iOptLevel=5, dAutoMergeTinyFacesAngle=0.5235987756, bGeomApprox=True, iNextEntityOffsetId=0)) meshing_status = Meshing.SurfaceMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1)], surfaceMesh=SURFACE_MESH(dGeomAngle=0.7853981634, iOptLevel=5, dAutoMergeTinyFacesAngle=0.5235987756, bGeomApprox=True, iNextEntityOffsetId=0)) JPT.Debugger(meshing_status)

title: Description​
content: Copy local mesh setting from one to another.

title: Syntax​
content: Meshing.Templates.TemplateCopy(...)  Macro: TemplateCopy Ribbon: Meshing » Templates » TemplateCopy

title: crlReferent​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the reference item (a Face or a Part). The local mesh setting set on this reference item will be copied.This is a required input.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the target item (a Face or a Part). The local mesh setting copied from reference item will be set on this target item if the two items are similar. Similarity conditions base on the selected iMethod.This is a required input.

title: iMethod​
content: An Integer specifying the method for similarity conditions. If iMethod = 0: By Shape position: the two items are similar if their shape sizes are the same.If iMethod = 1: By topology: the two items are similar if their topology classifications are the same. The default value is 0.

title: iCopySub​
content: An Integer to enable or disable the copy of local mesh setting on sub-items. If selected target is Part, local mesh settings on Faces and Edges will be copied.If selected target is Face, local mesh settings on Edges will be copied. The default value is 1.

title: dTolerance​
content: A Double specifying the tolerance distance for similarity test.The default value is 0.001.

title: strSource​
content: A String specifying the name of the Jupiter doc to copy.The default value is "".

title: strTarget​
content: A String specifying the name of the Jupiter doc to paste.The default value is "".

title: Return Code​
content: A Boolean of True if success, or False if fail.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube(iPartColor=12999622) Geometry.MakeFillet(crlEdges=[Edge(18, 19, 15)]) Meshing.LocalSettings.Face(strName="MeshParam_1", localMesh=LOCAL_MESH(iEntityType=2, bEnableSizeParams=True, dAvgElemSize=0.002, dMaxElemSize=0.01, dMinElemSize=0.001, bEnableMeshPattern=True, iMeshPatternType=1), crlTargets=[Face(27, 28, 29)]) Geometry.Part.Cube(strName="Cube_2", iPartColor=7731705) Geometry.MakeFillet(crlEdges=[Edge(93, 90, 94)]) copy_status = Meshing.Templates.TemplateCopy(crlReferent=[Part(1)], crlTargets=[Part(2)], dTolerance=1e-06) JPT.Debugger(copy_status)  備考 Example of window to window case. Geometry.Part.Cube() Geometry.MakeFillet(crlEdges=[Edge(18, 19, 15)]) Meshing.Templates.TemplateCopy(dTolerance=1e-06, strSource="Jupiter2", strTarget="Jupiter1") In this example, [Jupiter2] window will have the same local mesh setting with the [Jupiter1] window.

title: Description​
content: Define a shell property of 2D composite material.

title: Syntax​
content: Properties.Composite(...)  Ribbon: Properties » Composite

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the new property.The default value is "ComMatShell1".

title: iPropertyColor​
content: An Integer specifying the color of the new property.The default value is "".

title: iFT​
content: An Integer specifying the Failure Theory for composite materials: 0: No Failure Theory is specified.1: The Hill theory.2: The Hoffman theory.3: The Tsai-Wu theory.4: The Maximum Strain theory. The default value is 0.

title: dGE​
content: A Double specifying the Structural Damping coefficient.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iLAM​
content: An Integer specifying the Laminate options: 0: Not specified - All plies must be specified and all stiffness terms are developed.1: "SYM" - Only plies on one side of the laminate centerline are specified. The plies are numbered starting with 1 for the bottom ply. If the laminate contains an odd number of plies, then model the center ply as half the thickness of the actual center ply.2: "MEM" - All plies must be specified, but only membrane terms (MID1 on the derived PSHELL entry) are computed.3: "BEND" - All plies must be specified, but only bending terms (MID2 on the derived PSHELL entry) are computed.4: "SMEAR" - All plies must be specified, stacking sequence is ignored, MID1=MID2 on the derived PSHELL entry and MID3, MID4 and TS/T and 12I/T**3 terms are set to zero.5: "SMCORE" - Face plies on one side of the laminate and the core are specified to define a laminate that is symmetric about the midplane of the core. The core is specified last. When calculating face sheet stiffness, stacking sequence of the face sheets is ignored. The default value is 0.

title: crMaterial​
content: A Cursor specifying the material will be applied for composite property.The default value is None.

title: dNSM​
content: A Double specifying the non-structural mass per unit length which is a contribution to the model mass from features that have negligible structural stiffness.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iPID​
content: An Integer specifying the property identification number. This number must be unique with respect to all other property identification numbers.The default value is 0.

title: dSB​
content: A Double specifying the allowable shear stress of the bonding material (allowable interlaminar shear stress). Required if iFT is also specified.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: iSOUT​
content: An Integer specifying whether to control individual ply stress and strain print or punch output. 0: Not specified - Not control individual ply stress and strain print or punch output1: NO - Not control individual ply stress and strain print or punch output2: YES - Control individual ply stress and strain print or punch output The default value is 0.

title: dTREF​
content: A Double specifying the Reference temperature.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dZ0​
content: A Double specifying the laminate offsets.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dZOFF​
content: A Double specifying the amount of offset of the laminate.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the entities to be applied to the composite property.The crlTargets and crCompositeProperty arguments are mutually exclusive (one of them must be specified).The default value is [].

title: crCompositeProperty​
content: A Cursor specifying the existing Composite Property. If this argument is not None, the specified Composite Property will be modified.Otherwise, a new Composite Property will be created. The crlTargets and crCompositeProperty arguments are mutually exclusive (one of them must be specified).The default value is None.

title: crLocalCS​
content: A Cursor specifying the local coordinate system used to define the material axis of the element.It must be specified if the specified iOrientationMethod is 1 (Coordinate System).The default value is None.

title: iOrientationMethod​
content: An Integer specifying method to define the material axis of the element. 0: Theta - Use the dlOrientationVector value.1: Coordinate System - Use the coordinate system crLocalCS. The X-axis of the coordinate system is projected to the element plane. The default value is 0.

title: dlOrientationVector​
content: A Vector specifying orientation angle of the longitudinal direction of each ply with the material axis of the element.It must be specified if the specified iOrientationMethod is 0 (Theta).The default value is [DFLT_DBL, DFLT_DBL, DFLT_DBL].

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the newly created or the modified Composite Property.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() Properties.Material.Add("Structural_Steel", [Density([(DENSITY, 7.85e-09)]), Elastic([(YOUNGS_MODULUS, 200000.0), (POISSONS_RATIO, 0.3)])]) Properties.Composite(strName="ComMatShell1", iPropertyColor=16131973, crMaterial=Material(1), iPID=1, crlTargets=[Face(26)])

title: Description​
content: Create the property 3d Cohesive for solid element.

title: Syntax​
content: Properties.Cohesive(...)  Macro: Prop3DCohesive Ribbon: Properties » Cohesive

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the new property.This is a required input.

title: crMaterial​
content: A Cursor specifying the material will be applied for cohesive property.This is a required input.

title: iResponse​
content: An Integer specifying the response characteristics. 0: Traction Separation.1: Continuum.2: Gasket. This is a required input.

title: bSpecifyThick​
content: A Boolean specifying the initial thickness. False: Geometry - Calculated from the coordinate values of the node.True: Specified - Specified by user input. This is a required input.

title: dInitialThick​
content: A Double specifying the initial thickness value when bSpecifyThick is false.This is a required input.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the entities to be applied the composite property. The crlTargets and crEdit arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specifiedThis is a required input.

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying the existing cohesive property. If this argument is not None, the specified cohesive property will be modified. Otherwise, a new cohesive property will be created. The crlTargets and crEdit arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is None.

title: iFLG​
content: An Integer specifying the Duplication checking option. This option is used only for reassigning cohesive property for the Part which already had cohesive property. The purpose is to let user can control the Duplication could be allowed when creating cohesive property for Part or Element. -1: Disable check duplication option, creating cohesive property item without checking duplication in selected Part or Element. This option allow creating multi-duplicated cohesive property item for same part0: Enable check duplication option, the property will be assigned only to bodies that do not have the property assigned yet1: Enable check duplication option, the Part or element which is already existing cohesive property will be changed to new cohesive property The default value is 0.

title: iId​
content: An Integer specifying the property identification number. This number must be unique with respect to all other property identification numbers.The default value is 0.

title: iSolverType​
content: An Integer specifying the solver type. 0: ABAQUS.1: ADVC. The default value is 0.

title: iADVCResponseType​
content: An Integer specifying the ADVC response type. 0: Continuum.1: Continuum2. The default value is 0.

title: iADVCStackDir​
content: An Integer specifying the ADVC stack direction. 0: blank.1: 0.2: 1.3: 2. The default value is 0.

title: iEnableADVCThickness​
content: An Integer specifying whether or not enable ADVC thickness.The default value is 0.

title: dADVCThickness​
content: A Double specifying the ADVC thickness when enable ADVC thickness.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created cohesive property.

title: Sample Code​
content: Geometry.Part.Cube() Properties.Material.Add("Structural_Steel", [Density([(DENSITY, 7.85e-09)]), Elastic([(YOUNGS_MODULUS, 200000.0), (POISSONS_RATIO, 0.3)])]) Meshing.SolidMeshing(crlParts=[Part(1)], dGradingFactor=1.05, dStretchLimit=0.1, iSpeedVsQual=1, iRegion=1, bSafeMode=False, iParallel=16, bInternalMeshOnly=False, iPartColor=65280) created_prop = Properties.Cohesive(strName="Cohensive Property 1", iPropertyColor=13708224, crMaterial=Material(1), iResponse=0, bSpecifyThick=False, dInitialThick=DFLT_DBL, crlTargets=[Part(1)], iFLG=-1, iId=2) JPT.Debugger(created_prop)

title: Description​
content: Apply bar property on the selected entities.

title: Syntax​
content: Properties.BAR(...)  Macro: Property1DBar Ribbon: Properties » BAR

title: strName​
content: A String specifying the name of the new property.The default value is "".

title: iPropertyId​
content: An Integer specifying the identify number of the created property.The default value is 1.

title: iPropertyColor​
content: An Integer specifying the color of the created property.

title: crCrossSection​
content: A Cursor specifying the cross-sectional in the library. The crCrossSection and iShapeDataType arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is None.

title: iShapeDataType​
content: An Integer specifying the shape type from the default list. The crCrossSection and iShapeDataType arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is 0.

title: crMaterial​
content: A Cursor specifying the material will be applied for Bar property.The default value is None.

title: dSectionArea​
content: A Double specifying the area of bar cross-section. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dlSectionOrientation​
content: A List of Double specifying the orientation of bar cross-section.This is a required input.

title: dlInertiaMoment​
content: A List of Double specifying the three components area moments of inertia, expressed in the principal axis of the bar. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is [0.0,0.0,0.0].

title: dDatadTorConst​
content: A Double specifying the torsion constant which is involved in the relationship between angle of twist and applied torque along the axis of the bar. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDatadNSM​
content: A Double specifying the nonstructural mass per unit length which is a contribution to the model mass from features that have negligible structural stiffness. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDataShearAreaFactor0​
content: A Double specifying the area factor for shear for plane 1. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDataShearAreaFactor1​
content: A Double specifying the the area factor for shear for plane 2. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDataStressRecoveryCoeff0​
content: A Double specifying the stress recovery coefficients at the y-coordinate in the BAR element coordinate system of point C at which stresses are computed. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDataStressRecoveryCoeff1​
content: A Double specifying the stress recovery coefficients at the z-coordinate in the BAR element coordinate system of point C at which stresses are computed. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDataStressRecoveryCoeff2​
content: A Double specifying the stress recovery coefficients at the y-coordinate in the BAR element coordinate system of point D at which stresses are computed. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDataStressRecoveryCoeff3​
content: A Double specifying the stress recovery coefficients at the z-coordinate in the BAR element coordinate system of point D at which stresses are computed. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDataStressRecoveryCoeff4​
content: A Double specifying the stress recovery coefficients at the y-coordinate in the BAR element coordinate system of point E at which stresses are computed. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDataStressRecoveryCoeff5​
content: A Double specifying the stress recovery coefficients at the z-coordinate in the BAR element coordinate system of point E at which stresses are computed. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDataStressRecoveryCoeff6​
content: A Double specifying the stress recovery coefficients at the y-coordinate in the BAR element coordinate system of point F at which stresses are computed. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: dDataStressRecoveryCoeff7​
content: A Double specifying the stress recovery coefficients at the z-coordinate in the BAR element coordinate system of point F at which stresses are computed. This argument must be specified when the general section is chosen for crCrossSection.The default value is DFLT_DBL.

title: bDataPinA0​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the translation UX of the bar at end A.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinA1​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the translation UY of the bar at end A.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinA2​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the translation UZ of the bar at end A.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinA3​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the rotation RX of the bar at end A.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinA4​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the rotation RY of the bar at end A.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinA5​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the rotation RZ of the bar at end A.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinB0​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the translation UX of the bar at end B.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinB1​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the translation UY of the bar at end B.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinB2​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the translation UZ of the bar at end B.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinB3​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the rotation RX of the bar at end B.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinB4​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the rotation RY of the bar at end B.The default value is False.

title: bDataPinB5​
content: A Boolean specifying whether to remove the connection between the grid point and the rotation RZ of the bar at end B.The default value is False.

title: dlDataOffset0​
content: A List of Double specifying the offset vector of end point A.The default value is [DFLT_DBL, DFLT_DBL, DFLT_DBL].

title: dlDataOffset1​
content: A List of Double specifying the offset vector of end point B.The default value is [DFLT_DBL, DFLT_DBL, DFLT_DBL].

title: iLocalLengthUnit​
content: An Integer specifying the local unit as the units of length measurement. Possible values are 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 that correspond to mm, m, ft, in, and cm.The default value is 0.

title: iLocalMassUnit​
content: An Integer specifying the local unit as the units of mass measurement. Possible values are 0, 1 and 2 that correspond to t, kg, and kgf*s^2/mm.The default value is 0.

title: crlTargets​
content: A List of Cursor specifying the entities to be applied the Bar property. Possible targets are Bar Part, Edge, and 1D Element. The crlTargets and crEdit arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is [].

title: crEdit​
content: A Cursor specifying the existing Bar property. If this argument is not None, the specified Bar property will be modified. Otherwise, a new Bar property will be created. The crlTargets and crEdit arguments are mutually exclusive. One of them must be specified.The default value is None.

title: Return Code​
content: A Cursor specifying the created bar property.

content: Geometry.Part.Cube() Properties.Material.Add("Structural_Steel", [Density([(DENSITY, 7.85e-09)]), Elastic([(YOUNGS_MODULUS, 200000.0), (POISSONS_RATIO, 0.3)])]) Properties.Section.AddGeneral(strName="Circle", iSecGenType=2, dDsecGensizeT1=0.0002) created_prop = Properties.BAR(strName="BAR2", iPropertyId=2, iPropertyColor=15383527, crCrossSection=SectionGeneral(1), crMaterial=Material(1), dSectionArea=1.25664e-07, dlSectionOrientation=[1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dlInertiaMoment=[1.257e-15, 1.257e-15, 0.0], dTorionalConst=2.513e-15, dShearAreaFactorY=0.9, dShearAreaFactorZ=0.9, dStressRecoveryCoeffCy=0.0002, dStressRecoveryCoeffCz=0.0, dStressRecoveryCoeffDy=0.0, dStressRecoveryCoeffDz=0.0002, dStressRecoveryCoeffEy=-0.0002, dStressRecoveryCoeffEz=0.0, dStressRecoveryCoeffFy=0.0, dStressRecoveryCoeffFz=-0.0002, crlTargets=[Edge(19)]) JPT.Debugger(created_prop)
